title: Short-Form Video Editor
description: Short-Form Video Editor (Premiere Pro + After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve), Full-Time Remote, UK Agency About Us We're a London-based creative content consultancy producing short-form social content for a small portfolio of growing brands. Tight team, fast pace, no bureaucracy. Strict NDA on client names. The Role You'll edit 10 to 20 short-form pieces per week in Premiere Pro with After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve with Fusion — your call, work in whichever you ship fastest in. Footage and assets are delivered to you via Frame.io and Google Drive. You cut, caption, motion-design, sound-design, colour, and export to spec. We review, you revise, we ship. What you'll be editing (three repeating formats) 1) Podcast clips, talking-head with motion design 60 to 90 second vertical cuts pulled from long-form podcast recordings. Two-camera setup, separate audio tracks. Punchy hooks in the first 3 seconds, animated captions on-brand, lower thirds, light motion graphics (kinetic type, callouts, simple transitions). Sometimes paired with a matching square carousel for LinkedIn (5 to 8 slides in After Effects or Resolve Fusion, exported as PNGs or 1x1 video). 2) Talking-head videos with supplied B-roll 30 to 90 second vertical or square edits where we send you the A-roll (presenter to camera) and a B-roll package. You cut the talking head tightly, motivate B-roll insertions, add captions, light sound design, colour-match A and B-roll. No need to source footage — it's all supplied. 3) Static and animated carousels (occasional) LinkedIn and Instagram square carousels built from supplied copy and brand templates. 5 to 10 slides. Sometimes a short animated version for the lead slide. Weekly deliverables - 10 to 20 short-form pieces, mostly 15 to 90 seconds - Burned-in captions, brand-styled per client, accurate to audio - B-roll cutaways motivated by content (not pasted on top) - Light motion design (kinetic captions, callouts, lower thirds, end cards) - Clean H.264 exports to platform spec (1080x1920, 1080x1080, 1920x1080) - Organised project files returned to shared drive Must have - Fluent in either Premiere Pro + After Effects OR DaVinci Resolve + Fusion - Strong captioning craft (kinetic, on-brand, accurate, not auto-generated garbage) - Portfolio of at least 5 short-form edits you personally cut, including at least one podcast clip and one talking-head with B-roll - Fluent written and conversational English - Wired internet, minimum 50 Mbps down / 20 up - Machine able to run your chosen software smoothly, minimum 16GB RAM, dedicated GPU - Daily 4-hour overlap with UK hours (3pm to 11pm Manila works) Nice to have - Real motion design chops (kinetic type, simple 2D animation in AE or Fusion) - Carousel and static design (Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma) - Sound design and audio cleanup (iZotope RX, Fairlight, Audition) - Real colour grading beyond auto-balance - Familiarity with Frame.io, Notion, Slack Pay £500/month flat (approx PHP 35,000), paid via Wise on the 1st. 60-day review for raise to £550 to £650 based on quality and ownership. Paid trial task before hire: $40 USD flat on delivery. 13th-month bonus paid in December as standard. Mon to Fri, 6 to 8 hours daily. Your weekends are yours. How to apply 1. Start your email with the word "PARSNIP" as the first line. 2. Send to ---------- a) A 60-second Loom introducing yourself, showing your editing machine, and explaining one decision you made on a recent edit and why. b) Links to 3 short-form edits you personally cut. At least one podcast clip and one talking-head with B-roll. Tell me which one you're most proud of and which one you'd redo. c) Screenshot of fast.com speed test and your software version numbers. d) Your monthly rate expectation. e) One sentence: "What's the most common mistake editors make on the first 3 seconds of a short-form video?" 3. Subject line: PARSNIP, Short-Form Editor, [Your Name] We respond within 5 working days to every application.

title: Senior-Level Graphic Designer
description: We Are Hiring: Senior-Level Graphic Designer We are on the lookout for a highly skilled and experienced senior-level graphic designer to join our team on a long-term, ongoing, month-to-month basis. This is a role for a seasoned professional who can bring technical expertise, creative problem-solving, and a meticulous eye for detail to every project. What We’re Looking For We need a designer who: - Has strong technical design skills and a keen eye for detail. - Can self-manage projects and timelines to ensure on-time delivery without constant oversight. - Excels at following directions and adhering to project guidelines. Required Skills To excel in this role, you must have: - Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop). - Prepress knowledge and experience, including converting colors for print and file packaging. - The ability to correct minor errors, such as inconsistent capitalization in client-delivered content. - Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow directions precisely. - A creative approach to problem-solving. - Strong typography skills (e.g., fixing rags and kerning appropriately). - Real-world client experience. - The ability to recognize your limits and know when to push them. Bonus Skills If you have any of the following, you’ll stand out even more: - WordPress expertise (especially with DIVI). - Content writing capabilities. - Illustration skills. Typical Projects Here’s a glimpse of the types of projects you’ll work on: - Creating website mockups in Photoshop. - Laying out print brochures. - Updating or designing print ads. - Developing brand designs. - Crafting multipage brochures for companies. How We Work - We use Trello to manage projects. - Projects are typically assigned during the first half of the week. - Questions about a project should be asked within a day or two of assignment. - Working files must always be stored on our cloud drive. - Project time is tracked using our time-tracking software. - You’ll be provided with brand assets, working files, and access to stock images and graphics as needed. Compensation - This position pays $15 USD per hour. --- How to Apply To be considered, you must follow these instructions carefully. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be reviewed. Please provide: 1. A portfolio with at least 10 work samples. (If you only send 10 samples, prioritize longer-form design content such as reports, full ad campaigns, and white papers. Limit logos/brand designs to no more than two, and no more than two should be social media-related.) 2. Your Resume/CV. 3. A written explanation of what uniquely qualifies you for this position. 4. A response to the following: Are there any skills listed under “Required Skills” that you do not have? If so, explain why you feel you should still be considered. 5. A response to the following: Do you have any of the “Bonus Skills”? If yes, explain. If you have additional skills, let us know! 6. Confirmation of whether you consider yourself detail-oriented and able to follow directions precisely. 7. Your availability for a video interview in the next week (include days and times in EST). 8. Your availability to work (hours per week).

title: AutoCAD Drafter— Traffic Control Plans
description: We're commissioning a series of traffic control plans (work zone / road-work TCPs) based on existing reference standards. We need an experienced CAD drafter for an ongoing project, starting with a small paid trial. What this involves: - Working from a set of standard reference drawings that we'll provide. - For each one, producing matched sets — a reference version that follows the source standard exactly, plus several variations of it that deliberately deviate from the standard in specific, controlled ways. - Each plan must be produced in AutoCAD at actual scale, with the DXF model space in feet. The geometry must match the labels: if a distance is labeled "320 ft," the measured distance between the relevant sign insertion points in the DXF must equal 320 ft. This is the most important requirement of the project — many drafters label distances without actually drawing them to scale, and that won't work here. - For each plan, also producing a sidecar annotation file (JSON) recording the key dimensions used and, for the deviating versions, what was changed and where (with DXF coordinates). - Final output per plan: a layered DXF file in feet, plus the matching JSON file. Trial: We start with a small paid batch (6 plans from a single source). If the work is good, we scale up significantly from there — hundreds of plans over the following months. Pricing structure: - The 6-plan trial: paid at an agreed rate. - After the trial, the next ~10–15 plans are paid hourly while you build templates and internalize the workflow. - Once you're producing plans steadily, we switch to a per-plan rate based on your actual time during the hourly phase. The per-plan rate is structured so your effective hourly earnings stay higher than during ramp-up — efficient work pays off. Requirements: - Strong AutoCAD proficiency. Comfortable working in DXF/DWG with model-space units in feet, and you understand block insertion points. - Ability to read technical standards and apply them precisely — looking up values in tables, following the right formulas for the right cases. - Attention to detail. Geometry must match labels exactly. We will verify by measuring the DXF. - Comfortable producing structured JSON files alongside CAD output. - Good English communication. Helpful but not required: - Prior experience with traffic control plans, work zone drawings, or U.S.-style roadway standards. How to apply: 1. The Work: You'll produce two types of deliverables from raw 4K footage we provide: - Listing Reels (Vertical / 9:16) - 60–90 second social-format reels for Instagram. Shot selection, music, color grade, pacing. These are the bread and butter. - You'll edit 2–3 of these per day once you're ramped. - Cinematic Horizontal Videos (16:9) - 2–4 minute listing walkthroughs. Slower pace, more room to breathe. These take longer per piece but the footage is usually stronger. Typical daily output after your first two weeks: 2–3 completed videos. We provide the footage, music library, LUTs, and templates. Wedding, travel, and corporate reels don't count. We need someone who already knows how luxury property footage should move, breathe, and cut. If your portfolio doesn't have at least 3 real estate edits, this isn't the right fit. Strong color grading instincts. You know the difference between warm-and-inviting interiors and orange-tinted mistakes. You can match shots across rooms without everything looking like the same filter. You grade for accuracy first, mood second. A computer that handles 4K without choking. No proxy-only workflows. You need to be able to scrub through 4K drone footage and interior clips without lag. If your machine can't do that, this role will frustrate you. Reliable internet and a quiet workspace. We communicate async through Frame.io and messaging. You need to upload finished exports (150–250MB files) without it taking all day. Available 9AM–1PM Eastern (US) for overlap. The rest of your hours are flexible. But during that 4-hour window, you respond to messages and feedback within 30 minutes. What You Don't Need: You don't need to talk to clients. David handles all client communication. You don't need to own a camera or any recording equipment. Compensation: Guaranteed base: $1,400 USD/month Volume bonuses (stack on top of base): Videos 9–20/month: +$25 per video Videos 21–35/month: +$30 per video Videos 36+/month: +$35 per video Quality bonus: $100–$200/month We score every edit on a 100-point quality scorecard. Average score of 85+ earns $100/month. Score of 92+ earns $200/month. What this looks like in practice: Learning - 20 videos/month (ramp period) ~$1,675 Consistent 85+ - 35 videos/month - ~$2,275 Scoring 90+ - 45 videos/month - ~ $2,950 Scoring 92+ - 55 videos/month - ~$3,550 Your earnings scale directly with your speed and quality. Editors who produce more and score higher make more. No cap on volume bonuses. Payment: bi-weekly via Gusto Our Standards: We edit luxury real estate. The audience is buyers considering a $3M home purchase. Every frame matters. How We Work: Frame.io for project delivery and review. You upload exports, David leaves timestamped feedback, you revise. Async communication. No daily standups. No Zoom calls unless something specific needs a screen share. You post a daily status update ("On track, delivering 3 edits by 9AM EST" or "Flagging an issue with the drone footage on Project X"). Short messages, clear information. Feedback loop. Your first two weeks are supervised. David reviews every edit against the scorecard and walks you through the gaps. After 2 weeks, if your scores are consistently 80+, you move to independent delivery. David spot-checks rather than reviewing every project. Folder structure and naming conventions are standardized. We'll give you the full system on Day 1. Every project is organized the same way. No improvisation on file management. How to Apply Send three things: Your portfolio link. Must include at least 3 real estate video edits. If your portfolio is "available on request," don't apply. A short note (3–5 sentences) answering this: Pick one of your RE edits and tell me what creative decision you made that you're most proud of, and one thing you'd change if you could redo it. Your expected monthly rate and current availability (part-time or full-time). Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. One-line applications ("I'm interested, here's my resume") will not be reviewed. If you made it this far in the description, please add the word 'Banana' in the title of the email . Timeline We review applications within 5 business days Top candidates receive a trial edit for a 60-second reel from our raw footage Trial is scored on our 100-point quality scorecard If you pass (75+), we make an offer and start onboarding About WorldClass Creative We're a boutique luxury real estate media company based in West Palm Beach, Florida. It also means you need to be comfortable with some ambiguity in the early weeks while processes solidify. If that sounds like your kind of environment, apply.

title: Creative Designer (Meta Ads) – Parttime
description: We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the diabetic niche, focused on building high-converting ad creatives for Meta (Facebook & Instagram). We sell bamboo (compression) socks We are looking for a creative designer who understands what actually makes ads convert — not just someone who can design. What you’ll be doing - Create high-converting static ads for Meta - Design for different awareness levels: - Top of Funnel (attention / scroll-stop) - Middle of Funnel (problem / solution) - Bottom of Funnel (conversion / trust) - Work with clear customer avatars and structured briefings - Translate marketing angles into visual creatives Important We are not looking for someone who just “makes things look nice”. We’re looking for someone who understands: - why an ad works - what stops someone from scrolling - how design influences conversion Requirements - Proven experience with Meta ad creatives (static ads) - Strong design skills (layout, hierarchy, typography) - Understanding of direct response / performance marketing - Ability to think in angles, hooks and offers - Experience in the diabetic niche is a big plus What we offer - Part-time position - Long-term opportunity in a fast-growing company Application instruction If you’ve read this carefully, do the following: - Share your portfolio (Meta ads only, if possible) - Review our product: ---------- - Based on this product, describe: - 3 ad concepts you would create - why these ads would convert - which funnel stage they target (TOF / MOF / BOF) Start your message with: “Designs”

title: Signage & Wayfinding Designer| Remote-friendly | International Projects
job_title: Signage & Wayfinding Designer| Remote-friendly | International Projects
description: Most designers live in a 2D world of pixels and paper. Here, your work has weight, texture, and light. You won’t just be designing logos; you’ll be defining the physical landscape of places people live in. If you’ve ever looked at a building and thought, "That sign should be deeper," or "That finish should be bronze," you belong here. About Us We’re a trusted signage and graphics company based in the U.S., known for delivering both long-term contracts and fast-turnaround creative projects. Our team follows clear systems and standard operating procedures to ensure smooth execution and high-quality results every time. Role Overview We’re looking for a creative powerhouse who understands Design Intent. You should be able to visualize 3D objects in a physical space and provide clear aesthetic directions. You will lead the "vision" phase—selecting the colors, textures, and scales that make a property, office or retail space stand out. •	Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM CST. •	Location: 100% Remote / Work-from-home. •	Growth: Starting as a contract role with a clear path to increased hours and responsibility as you master our systems. What We’re Looking For •	7+ Years of Mastery: Expert-level skills in Adobe Illustrator (this is our primary tool). •	Architectural Literacy: Ability to read site maps and floor plans to visualize where signs "live." •	The 3D Eye: A natural sense of scale and an understanding of how 2D designs translate to 3D materials like aluminum and acrylic. •	Industry Experience: Proven background in Environmental Graphic Design (EGD) or Wide-Format Print. •	System-Oriented: You appreciate a team that has clear SOPs and organized workflows. Key Responsibilities •	Transform Spaces: Create "Design Intent" packages for multifamily developments, including entry monuments, wayfinding, and ADA-compliant interior systems. •	Branding and Marketing via Wall Wraps, Fleet Graphics, and other large-format products. •	Creative Collaboration: Work with our international team to move projects from a site map to a finished installation. •	Production Prep: Prepare precise vector files in Illustrator, ensuring color accuracy and brand consistency across all mediums. Why Join Us? • Work with an international, process-driven team • Get exposure to large-scale and quick-turn projects • Showcase your creativity and build a long-term working relationship

description: Application Requirements: 1. Use at least 10AP for your application. 2. Include "Senior Video Editor Pro" in your subject line. Note: Applications missing either requirement will not be considered. _________________________________________________________ About Veritas Vans Veritas Vans builds the most trusted accessories for Starlink Mini and Starlink Standard. Our mission is to give people the freedom to work, explore, and stay connected anywhere. From Baja coastlines to deep forest trails, our customers rely on our gear for capability, protection, and unlimited connection. Your role is to help visually tell this story across all platforms. Role Overview We are hiring a Senior Video Editor who can own our long-form YouTube content, high-retention short-form content, and graphic design needs. You must be highly experienced, creative, fast, and able to work autonomously within a growing brand. Responsibilities Video Editing – Long Form - Edit 6–15 minute YouTube videos with strong retention, pacing, and narrative clarity. - Add b-roll, overlays, captions, music, and brand-consistent graphics. - Build engaging openings with proven YouTube hook methods. Video Editing – Short Form - Execute the Hook ? Retain ? Reward method for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. - Add dynamic subtitles, zooms, cuts, ---------- inserts, and pacing adjustments. - Produce scroll-stopping, high-retention content. Graphic Design & Photo Editing - Create YouTube thumbnails and graphic assets. - Design text treatments, overlays, and promotional visuals. - Edit lifestyle and product photos for multi-platform use. Brand Storytelling - Align all edits with our brand themes: freedom, connection, capability, control. - Contribute creative ideas and concepts for future video content. AI-Driven Editing & Workflow Optimization - Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Adobe AI, Topaz, Descript, etc.) as a core part of your editing workflow. - Generate high-performing hooks, captions, and on-screen text callouts using AI. - Use AI to research and improve storytelling, pacing, and content structure. - Continuously explore and implement new AI workflows to improve output quality, speed, and efficiency. - Leverage AI to enhance both creative output and production throughput, not just assist basic tasks. Cross-Platform Optimization - Edit in multiple aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, 1:1. - Prepare final deliverables in organized, structured folders. - Optimize content for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook . Collaboration - Work closely with the content team and leadership. - Follow SOPs and meet deadlines consistently. - Join scheduled calls proactively (no reminders required) - Be punctual and prepared for feedback sessions Work Discipline & Delivery Standards - Be actively available and responsive during working hours (PST schedule). - Address tasks, revisions, and team communication within working hours. - Meet deadlines consistently and communicate early if delays occur. - Submit deliverables early in the workday whenever possible to allow time for review and revisions. Quality & Output Standards - Deliver edits that are near publish-ready on first submission. - Ensure drafts require minimal revisions and are not incomplete or partially executed. - Perform a full self-review before submission to ensure: - all feedback is applied - no new issues are introduced - output meets brand and quality standards - Maintain consistently high production quality across all deliverables. Required Skills - Ability to work graveyard shift (PST hours) - 3–5+ years professional video editing experience - Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro - Strong skills in After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma - Proven experience editing YouTube content and high-performing short-form videos - Strong understanding of retention, pacing, story structure, and attention engineering - Experience creating high-converting thumbnails - Strong understanding of modern content trends across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok - Ability to edit lifestyle, outdoor, product, and UGC-style content AI & Workflow Skills (Required) - Strong proficiency in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Adobe AI, etc.) within editing workflows - Ability to generate hooks, captions, and on-screen text using AI - Experience using AI to improve storytelling, pacing, and video performance - Ability to research and implement new AI workflows to improve efficiency and output quality Work Ethic & Discipline - Highly reliable, responsive, and accountable - Strong attention to detail and ability to self-review work - Ability to follow feedback precisely and minimize repeated revisions Bonus Experience - Motion graphics or animation skills. - Experience in e-commerce, outdoor brands, or creator channels. - Understanding of YouTube SEO (titles, thumbnails, keywords). - Ability to generate ideas for hooks, storylines, and visual treatments. What We Offer - Long-term employment with growth potential. - Competitive salary based on experience. - Consistent weekly workload. - Direct impact on a fast-scaling global brand. - Creative freedom and an opportunity to lead our video direction. How to Apply Submit the following: - Resume - Short explanation of why you’re the right fit - Brief explanation of how you use AI in your editing workflow - 1 example where you improved video performance (retention, CTR, etc.) - Portfolio of your best long-form and short-form edits - Links to YouTube channels or brands you’ve edited for Learn About Us: ---------- ---------- ---------- Website: ----------

Deliverable: 4 videos to completion, max 2 revision rounds each. You receive a full style guide, reference videos, and written feedback on every edit. Month 4+ — Established rate & full-time opportunity Strong performers move to $600–$650/month part-time. As the channel grows, the right person moves into a full-time role with expanded scope and expanded pay. I don't churn editors. I grow with them. Doesn't have to be fluent; we use translation tools both ways. - Portfolio of edits in the beauty / aesthetics / lifestyle / fashion niche specifically --- NICE-TO-HAVE --- - Experience editing beauty-education / aesthetic content - Familiarity with trending TikTok audio sourcing - AI tools workflow: ElevenLabs voiceover swaps, automatic captions (Submagic, Captions.ai) - Speak any of French / Polish / Spanish / Italian (big bonus for QC'ing localized variants — NOT required) - Some Photoshop / Illustrator for thumbnail and asset prep --- COMPENSATION --- $700/month for the first 30-day paid trial (3 master reels/week, deliver on time, hit our quality bar). Bumps to $900–1,100/month after a successful trial. Plus 13th-month and a performance bonus tied to retention metrics (average % watched on the reels you cut). --- HOURS --- Approx. 30–40h/week. Mostly async, but available at least 2 hours/day overlap with CET (so ~3 PM – 5 PM Manila time minimum). --- TO APPLY, SEND ME --- 1. Your reel: a 60-second showreel of your best short-form edits, with timestamps indicating which clips are yours. 2. 3 links to specific reels you edited that performed well (we will check the metrics). 3. Your CapCut OR Premiere project file for ONE of those reels, so we can see your timeline and layer organization (you can scrub client names). 4. The word reels at the very top of your reply so we know you read this whole post. 5. Your salary expectation. Applications missing any of these will be ignored.

title: META ADS VIDEO EDITOR
description: We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly: A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business. We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for Facebook , Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality. This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING --- You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: — Facebook and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases — UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly — AI talking-head and avatar-based ads: built using tools like HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar — Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action — Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after ---------- nts, and social proof — VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure — Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures — Localized creatives for new European markets as we expand --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --- We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to leverage AI to create them at scale. You should know how to edit videos that: — Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds — Make the problem feel real and urgent — Show the product clearly and persuasively — Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention — Feel native to Facebook , Instagram, and TikTok — Communicate benefits quickly and clearly — Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof — Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. --- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- This is a core part of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in: — Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar) — Generating AI voiceovers in multiple languages and tones (ElevenLabs or similar) — Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough — Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit — Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who knows how to get the best output with the fewest wasted credits — Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources — Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus) — Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative — Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, b-roll) — Can create multiple ad variations quickly — Know how to follow references without copying them blindly — Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow — Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused — Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets — Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast — Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion. --- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE --- Ideally, you have experience with: — Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands — Short-form paid social videos — Long-form VSLs or sales videos — AI-generated UGC, avatar, and b-roll content — Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing — Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway, Kling, or similar AI generation platforms Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- — Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references — Generating AI b-roll, avatars, and voiceovers as part of the production pipeline — Creating variations of winning ads for further testing — Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs — Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok) — Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand — Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control — Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance — Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations --- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU --- — Competitive compensation based on experience — Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives — Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us — The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets — Clear creative direction and fast feedback — Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale. If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you. --- READY TO APPLY? --- If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply here: ----------

title: Graphic Designer
description: Keenya Kelly LLC is a fast-moving social media education and content strategy company based in Houston, Texas. Our founder, Keenya Kelly, is a TikTok and Instagram Growth Strategist who has built a \ business over the last decade — primarily through short-form video. We help entrepreneurs grow their audiences and generate real revenue through strategic content. We move fast, we have high standards, and we care deeply about the quality of everything that represents our brand. If you love creating visuals that stop people mid-scroll, make them feel something, and ultimately move them to take action — this is your kind of team. THE ROLE We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and fast-executing Part-Time Graphic Designer who can produce high-quality, on-brand marketing visuals that do more than just look good — they convert. This is not a role for someone who simply places text on a background and calls it a graphic. We need a designer who understands marketing psychology, knows what catches attention in a social media feed, and can translate our brand strategy into visuals that sell our programs and services. This is a long-term remote position for someone who is fast, communicative, and takes ownership of their work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Social Media Graphics Design scroll-stopping graphics for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook , and LinkedIn that are aligned with current campaigns and promotions Create visuals that are built for marketing — not just aesthetically pleasing, but strategically designed to attract attention and drive action Produce graphics for organic content, launch campaigns, webinar promotions, challenge graphics, and product announcements Design Stories, Reels cover images, carousels, and feed posts that stay consistent with our brand Launch & Promotional Materials Create full suites of promotional graphics for course launches, membership campaigns, challenges, and webinars Design email header graphics, sales page visuals, and promotional banners Produce countdown graphics, announcement posts, and urgency-based visuals for cart open/close sequences Design affiliate-ready promotional assets when needed Brand Consistency & Asset Management Follow our Brand Style Guide with precision — colors, fonts, logo placement, spacing, and tone must be exact Maintain an organized library of brand templates, completed assets, and source files Resize and adapt existing assets across platforms and formats without losing visual quality Flag any design inconsistencies or outdated brand elements proactively Collaboration & Communication Receive creative briefs and turn them around in a timely, efficient manner Ask clarifying questions before starting — not after spending hours going in the wrong direction Communicate proactively if a deadline is at risk — no surprises Accept feedback professionally and implement revisions quickly WHO YOU ARE The right person for this role is someone who: Creates custom, original graphics from scratch — not relying on AI-generated imagery or generic stock templates as a shortcut Understands the difference between a pretty graphic and a marketing graphic — and consistently delivers the latter Has a strong eye for layout, hierarchy, color, and visual storytelling that stops a scroll Knows how to use ChatGPT or other AI tools for quick copyediting, brainstorming caption ideas, or rapid ideation — but does not use AI as a replacement for original creative design work Can turn around quality graphics efficiently — speed and quality are both non-negotiable on a launch-driven team Reads a creative brief thoroughly and asks smart questions before diving in Keeps files organized, properly named, and easy to hand off Takes brand guidelines seriously and follows them without needing constant correction Has experience designing for online businesses, personal brands, courses, memberships, or digital products Is deeply familiar with TikTok, Instagram, Facebook , and LinkedIn as platforms — and knows what performs visually on each WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR To help you self-select, here is what this role is not: This is not a role for someone who produces one graphic per several hours of work — we need efficient, capable output This is not a fit for someone who leans on AI image generation tools as their primary creative process This is not a fit for someone who needs extensive hand-holding to execute a standard design brief This is not a role for someone who treats brand guidelines as suggestions TOOLS & PLATFORMS You should be proficient in the following: Design (Required) Canva — advanced proficiency required Design (Preferred) Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or InDesign AI Tools ChatGPT for ideation/copy support only — not design generation File Sharing Google Drive or Dropbox for asset delivery Communication WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS You are a trusted creative partner on this team. Our brand looks consistent, polished, and sharp across every platform and every campaign. You deliver graphics quickly, require minimal revisions, and proactively flag anything that could make our content stronger. Launches feel smooth because the visual assets are always ready on time. POSITION DETAILS Employment Type Part-Time with availability during US Central Time business hours for communication Reporting To Adora (OBM / Operations Lead) and Keenya Kelly (CEO) Start Date Immediate HOW TO APPLY To be considered for this role, please submit the following: A link to your portfolio — we want to see extensive examples of marketing graphics you have created for online businesses, personal brands, digital products, courses, or memberships A brief written introduction: who you are, what kind of design work you do best, and why you are a strong fit for a fast-moving personal brand team Your available hours per week and preferred working schedule IMPORTANT — Portfolio Requirements Your portfolio must include marketing graphics — not just decorative or personal design work. We want to see graphics designed to promote a business, sell a product, run a campaign, or drive an audience to take action. If your portfolio does not include this type of work, this role is likely not the right fit at this time. We review every application and look forward to seeing your work. Only applicants who submit a complete portfolio and introduction will be considered.

title: Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor – 20 hrs/week
job_title: Cinematic Real Estate Video Editor – 20 hrs/week
description: Real Estate Video Editor – Part-Time (Remote, Philippines) Carlson Home Photography | Kansas City, MO | $7/hr | 20 hrs/week About Us Carlson Home Photography is a premium real estate media company based in Kansas City, Missouri. We shoot and deliver photography, video, drone, and 3D tours for residential real estate agents and builders across the KC metro. We've been growing fast and we have high standards — our agents expect polished, professional work that makes their listings stand out. We currently produce a high volume of listing videos every week, and we're bringing on a dedicated in-house video editor to handle our premium and standard edit queue. What You'll Be Editing -Standard listing videos — 1-minute cinematic walk-through videos for residential properties. Clean cuts, smooth transitions, music sync, color grading, and lower thirds with property address and agent info. Drone footage is included in most shoots. -Luxury/higher-end listing videos — Same format with elevated attention to color grading, pacing, and overall cinematic feel. When footage arrives with a luxury designation, we expect the edit to reflect that — more care, more craft. -Vertical reels — Short-form social media cuts reformatted for Instagram/Facebook. We want every project treated with care and expertise. Standard edits should still look great. When footage comes in marked as a luxury edit, bring everything you have to it. Turnaround Expectations This is the most important part of this role. Please read carefully. -Standard edits: We typically deliver footage to you in the evening (CST). We need the completed edit back in our inbox by 8am CST the following morning. That is roughly a 12-hour turnaround. -Luxury edits: 24-hour turnaround from the time footage is delivered to you. -Corrections and revisions: Small corrections — an address typo, a clip order change, a minor color adjustment — should be turned around within one hour of being submitted, during your active morning window (see schedule below). We're not asking you to stay up all night. But during the hours you're available, we need quick responses. If you cannot consistently meet these turnaround windows, this role is not a good fit. Schedule This is a part-time remote position at approximately 20 hours per week. You have full flexibility in when you complete your edit hours. However, we do require that you are available and responsive Tuesday through Saturday, 8am–11am CST (9pm–midnight Philippines time). During those hours, we may send correction requests, and we need a response and turnaround within one hour for simple fixes. You don't need to be actively editing during that window — just engaged and reachable. Outside of those hours, your time is your own. What We're Looking For -Strong color grading skills — This is the most important technical skill. We shoot in log or flat profiles and need someone who can bring footage to life with a natural, premium look. Not overly processed. Not flat. Clean and cinematic. -Real estate and architectural video experience required — This is not negotiable. We need someone who understands the format deeply: property walk-throughs, architectural framing, lower thirds, drone integration, music pacing for real estate. A general video editing background is not enough. Your portfolio should reflect this. -Reliable and communicative — We need someone who confirms receipt of footage, flags problems early, and doesn't go quiet. If something is going to be late, you tell us before the deadline, not after. -Attention to detail — Address typos, wrong agent names, misaligned text, music cutting off abruptly — these things matter to our clients. You catch them before we do. -Self-sufficient — We're a lean team. We'll give you clear direction and brand standards, but we're not going to micromanage the edit queue. You manage your own time and hit your deadlines. Software & Equipment -We're open to Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. Use what you know best — we care about the output, not the tool. You will need to provide your own computer and editing software. -We have an active Artlist subscription and will provide you access for music licensing on all projects. Compensation $7.00 USD per hour ~20 hours per week (approximately 80 hours per month) Paid weekly or bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal How to Apply Please send the following: 1. A link to your portfolio or sample reel — ideally including real estate video work, but other cinematic work is fine. We want to see your color grading and editing style. 2. A brief note about your experience — What kind of video work have you done? How long have you been editing professionally? 3. Answer this question: On average, how long does it take you to complete a standard 1-minute cinematic listing video edit from raw footage to final delivery? Be honest — we're not looking for the fastest answer, we're looking for the most accurate one. 4. Confirm you can meet our turnaround windows — Standard edits back within 12 hours, luxury within 24 hours, corrections within 2 hours during business hours CST. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial edit using real footage from a recent shoot. We are a small, systems-driven team that takes our work seriously and treats our contractors well. If you're reliable, talented, and want consistent part-time work with room to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

title: META ADS VIDEO EDITOR
description: We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly: A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business. We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for Facebook , Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality. This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING --- You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including: — Facebook and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases — UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly — AI talking-head and avatar-based ads: built using tools like HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar — Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action — Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after ---------- nts, and social proof — VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure — Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures — Localized creatives for new European markets as we expand --- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --- We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to leverage AI to create them at scale. You should know how to edit videos that: — Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds — Make the problem feel real and urgent — Show the product clearly and persuasively — Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention — Feel native to Facebook , Instagram, and TikTok — Communicate benefits quickly and clearly — Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof — Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. --- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- This is a core part of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in: — Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar) — Generating AI voiceovers in multiple languages and tones (ElevenLabs or similar) — Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough — Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit — Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who knows how to get the best output with the fewest wasted credits — Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources — Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus) — Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative — Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, b-roll) — Can create multiple ad variations quickly — Know how to follow references without copying them blindly — Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow — Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused — Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets — Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast — Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion. --- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE --- Ideally, you have experience with: — Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands — Short-form paid social videos — Long-form VSLs or sales videos — AI-generated UGC, avatar, and b-roll content — Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing — Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway, Kling, or similar AI generation platforms Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- — Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references — Generating AI b-roll, avatars, and voiceovers as part of the production pipeline — Creating variations of winning ads for further testing — Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs — Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok) — Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand — Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control — Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance — Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations --- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU --- — Competitive compensation based on experience — Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives — Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us — The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets — Clear creative direction and fast feedback — Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale. If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you. --- READY TO APPLY? --- If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply here: ----------

We want viewers to feel: *"Clear, calm, confident guidance."* Style references: - Graham Stephan - Ali Abdaal - Mark Tilbury --- ## What You'll Be Editing You will primarily edit: - talking-head educational videos - financial storytelling content - mortgage strategy content - real-world buyer scenarios Typical long-form videos: - 5–10 minutes You will also create: - YouTube Shorts - Instagram Reels - TikTok clips - LinkedIn vertical clips --- ## Responsibilities ### Long-Form Editing You will: - remove mistakes, pauses, filler words - tighten pacing for retention - add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts - add clean captions and text emphasis - add occasional b-roll and overlays - integrate provided infographics and visuals - use light background music and subtle sound design - maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style ### Short-Form Content From each long-form video: - identify strong hook moments - create 5–7 vertical clips - format properly for 9:16 platforms - add captions and pacing optimized for retention - create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video **IMPORTANT:** Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries. ### Thumbnails You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video: - clean, modern design - clear focal point - readable text at small sizes - consistent with channel branding ### Visual / Graphics Work You may occasionally: - add simple motion graphics - integrate charts and infographics - use stock footage selectively - organize visuals to improve understanding Most visuals and scripts will be provided. --- ## Editing Style Requirements We are looking for editors who understand: - pacing - storytelling rhythm - educational retention - visual clarity - modern YouTube editing This is NOT meme editing. We prefer: - clean cinematic pacing - calm confidence - modern documentary feel - clarity over flashy effects --- ## NON-NEGOTIABLES ### Accuracy Matters This is financial and mortgage content. All: - text - numbers - names - graphics - statistics MUST match the spoken audio exactly. Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit. ### Communication We value: - responsiveness - reliability - professionalism - clear communication - consistency If deadlines change, communicate early. Your editing software 5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video 6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail) 7. Your internet speed 8. Your ---------- or WhatsApp **IMPORTANT:** Start your application message with the word: **"EVEREST"** --- ## Auto-Disqualifiers We will not consider applicants who: - Don't include the word "EVEREST" at the start of their message - Don't include portfolio examples - Quote rates wildly outside our range without explanation - Take more than 48 hours to respond during the application process --- ## Trial Process Selected editors will complete a paid trial edit. description: I run a growing 3D animated faceless YouTube channel modeled on Zack D Films, and I'm hiring a long-term storyboard artist who is the bridge between the script and the final animated short. This is the most important hire on my team — the storyboard is what makes or breaks the video. Main Responsibility — Storyboarding (60% of your time) For every approved script you receive, you'll break it down into small sentences (one beat per frame) and turn it into a storyboard. For each sentence you'll provide: A clear visual instruction (camera angle, character action, expression, environment) A reference image (a screenshot from a similar Zack D Films short, a movie still, or a real photo — anything that shows the animator exactly what you mean) Timing notes if the beat needs special pacing (slow zoom, hard cut, hold-for-laugh) A 3D animator should be able to open your storyboard, look at sentence #14, and animate that frame without asking you a single question. Voiceover Production (15%) Use Elevenlabs to create the voice over then use Audacity to trim the VoiceOver with fullstops, etc. Animator Feedback Loop (15%) Once the 3D animators deliver a draft, you review it against the storyboard. If something is off — wrong camera angle, off timing, expression doesn't match the line — you write clear revision notes with timestamps and (where useful) annotated screenshots. You keep this loop running until the final video matches our quality bar. Channel Management (10%) Upload finished videos to YouTube with the right title, description, tags, thumbnail Schedule uploads on our posting cadence Reply to comments to drive engagement (you'll be given a tone guide) Flag comments that need my attention (sponsorships, collabs, complaints) You'll be given on Day 1: Full Zack D Films scripting SOP, reverse-engineered storyboard reference Zack D Films shorts, animator brief + revision-note templates, channel SOP, voiceover sample reels. ? BIG PLUS — 3D Animation Skills (Higher Pay) If you can also do 3D animation (Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or similar), this is a major plus. I'll send 3D animation work your way on top of the storyboarding role, and your monthly salary goes up accordingly — see the salary breakdown below. If you're a strong storyboard artist AND a competent 3D animator, you're exactly who I want on this team long-term. Who You Are: You've worked on at least one animated YouTube channel before (unpaid passion projects count if the work is good) Strong visual sense — when you read "he slowly opened the door," you immediately picture the angle, lighting, and lens Clear, natural-sounding English. Voice samples required You read briefs carefully and ask clarifying questions early instead of guessing Available for one 30-minute video call per week Can commit 6+ months. No 1-month contracts What this job is NOT: You will not be writing scripts (we have a scriptwriter). You will not be doing the 3D animation (we have animators). You will not be designing thumbnails (we have a thumbnail designer). You will be the bridge between script and animation. That's the whole job. HOW TO APPLY — follow this format exactly: 1. Start your message with the words "Frame 14" so I know you read the full post. 2. Portfolio: 1–3 links to storyboards or animated shorts you've worked on. If you don't have public examples, paste a 10-frame storyboard for this sentence: "I broke my brother's trophy and tried to hide it before he got home — but then I heard his key in the lock." Use any image references you want (Google Image links are fine). 3. Voice sample: A 30–60 second voiceover recording. Drive/Dropbox link, no attachments. 4. Zack D Films question: In 2–3 sentences, what makes a Zack D Films short work? What's the one thing he does that most copycat channels miss? 5. Availability: Your timezone, hours/week you can commit, and earliest start date. Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. I'm hiring for attention to detail — your application is the first test.

description: Senior Video Editor - Direct Response Performance Ads - Headlamp Brand Job Overview We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, already one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US to become the biggest globally. We scale through Meta paid ads and we're building our in-house creative team for the rest of 2026 and beyond. We're looking for a video editor to join us. This is a long-term collaborative role with strong base pay, real performance bonuses on winning ads, and a clear growth path if you're an A-player. Full-time preferred. Part-time considered for the right editor with strong availability through Q4. About Us We sell a product that genuinely makes people's lives better. The brand is founder-led, performance-driven, and growing fast. We have the strategy, the briefs, the creators, and the system already in place. What we need now is the right editor to execute at the level the brand and team deserves. We're scaling our ad spend significantly through Q4, which means we need editors who can deliver clean, high-converting direct response ads at speed without compromising quality. Focused on understanding the stories and narratives we create and turning them into great ads. What You'll Be Doing You'll be editing UGC ads, Voiceover ads, founder-style content, mashups, and AI-assisted ads - all designed to convert. The output is direct response performance creative, not branded content. We care about hooks, retention, pacing, narrative, and clarity. The ads that spend the most for us are simple, natural, and don't feel like ads at all. A big part of the role is reviewing our top-spending ads, understanding why they work, and using that to iterate on what we make next. We build feedback loops here - every brief is better than the last, and every editor on the team gets sharper with each ad they cut. You'll have briefs, creator footage, and the support of the team to do your best work. You'll work directly with the team to learn and improve what's working to drive the quality in the right direction. Communication is in English via Slack. What We're Looking For An editor who understands narrative, story, and direct response - and can read the type of ad and the concept we've built, and edit it in the way that fits it best. Creating ads that resonate with REAL PEOPLE. Specifically: - Strong portfolio of DTC/eCommerce ads that genuinely performed on Meta or TikTok - Deep understanding of hook craft, retention, pacing, and how ads convert - Fluent in UGC editing - clean, natural, organic feel - Experience in mashup, founder-style, and ugly ads - AI-fluent - we use ElevenLabs for voiceover, Higgsfield for AI B-roll, Nano Banana for images, and we're always exploring new tools - High-level written and spoken English - Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time - Able to deliver finished ads at a steady pace - typically 2-3 per day at peak (more if possible). - Cares about quality and craft, not just output volume We're pro-AI here. Full bonus structure shared once you pass the paid test brief. Growth Path This is a long-term role. The editor who delivers in Q4 becomes the senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression - more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, and direct collaboration on creative direction. How to Apply We're running a structured application process. Don't reply to this post - applications go through our application form here: ---------- The form takes 10-15 minutes. We're looking for editors who take it seriously and answer in their own words. If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand and creators. From there, the right editor joins the team and starts cutting paid work within the week. A Final Word An editor who chases volume and doesn't care about hook craft, engagement, or story - we're not the brand for you. If you're an editor who cares about every cut, every caption, every beat - who wants to be part of a serious team building one of the biggest brands in our space - apply through the form. We'll come back to you.

What We Expect From You: Software Mastery: You must be highly proficient in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro. Excellent English comprehension (you will edit to an English voiceover track). The "Look": You understand the modern "Video Essay" aesthetic. You know how to make still images dynamic (parallax) and how to explain complex data through simple, elegant animations. Attention to Detail: Timing is everything. Your edits must perfectly match the emotional beats of the voiceover. You can do your own sound design and color grading to create a cinematic atmosphere. ???? THE MANDATORY APPLICATION TEST We receive hundreds of applications from people who do not have the specific skills for this niche. To prove you are the right fit, you must complete two short 30-second test edits. We recommend to watch channels like "Fern" for inspiration. Below are the scripts. We have attached the recorded Voiceover audio files here, which are on purpose not perfect: ---------- Test 1: Storytelling & Atmosphere (ca. 30 Seconds) The Script: "May 1845. Two of the most advanced ships of their time, the HMS Erebus and Terror, set sail from England. Their goal: to conquer the Northwest Passage. They were equipped with steam engines, iron-reinforced hulls, and enough food for three years. But just two months later, they vanished into the Arctic ice. Not a single soul of the 129 crew members would ever be seen alive again. What happened in the freezing darkness?" Your Task: We want to see how you handle historical storytelling. Use archival photos, map animations, and add a subtle parallax (3D) effect to still images. Audio: Add suitable background music and rich sound design (e.g., cracking ice, wind, creaking wood) to make the story immersive. While the entire global GDP at the time was roughly 60 trillion dollars, the unregulated derivatives market had ballooned to an incomprehensible 600 trillion. When the housing bubble burst, this invisible web of debt didn't just collapse—it dragged the entire global economy down with it." Your Task: Do not use regular stock footage. Tell this entire 30-second segment using pure motion graphics, charts, and text animations in After Effects. Show us how you visualize the massive difference between 60 Trillion and 600 Trillion. job_title: Part-Time Canva Designer and Short Video Editor for Premium Children’s Brand
description: Job Description: I’m looking for a creative, reliable and detail-oriented part-time Canva Designer and Short Video Editor from the Philippines to help create weekly social media content for Organicline, a premium children’s clothing brand based in Australia. Organicline creates soft, clean and premium childrenswear content for Instagram, Facebook and ---------- . The brand style is warm, calm, minimal, modern and child-friendly. This is not a full social media strategy role. I provide the weekly direction, product focus, raw materials, captions, hooks, brand rules, software direction and creative guidance. Your role is to turn those materials into polished, premium-looking weekly content. I’m looking for someone with strong taste, good attention to detail and a real ability to make short videos feel alive, beautiful and scroll-stopping. What You Will Create Each Week: The regular weekly package includes: 14 Reels or short vertical videos Captions and hashtags Basic quality checking before delivery Final files prepared clearly for publishing Possible scheduling support through Meta Business Suite All videos must be vertical 9:16. Video content is very important for this role. Please do not apply if you only want to make static Canva graphics. What I Provide: I provide: Weekly content plan Product direction Raw Organicline photos and videos Brand rules Caption and hook guidance Creative direction Feedback and examples You do not need to invent the full strategy from zero. But you must be creative in how you bring the content to life. AI-Assisted Video Work: A key part of this role is turning existing Organicline photos, product images and short clips into premium 9:16 Reels. You should be comfortable using editing, motion, music, text overlays and, where appropriate, AI-assisted image-to-video tools such as Runway, Kling, Pika or similar. The final result must look natural, premium and realistic. We do not want obvious AI effects, distorted children, warped clothing, strange faces, fake scenes or cheap-looking edits. AI tools should support the final content. They should not make the brand look fake. What I Need From You: You must be able to: Create clean Canva graphics Edit short-form videos in Filmora, CapCut or a similar tool Turn still images and product assets into premium Reels Use pacing, movement, cropping, music and text to make videos more engaging Read instructions carefully Check English text before using it Notice if something sounds wrong, too technical or not suitable for public posting Ask questions before delivering anything unclear Avoid careless copy-paste mistakes Keep files organised Meet weekly deadlines Communicate clearly Nice To Have: Experience with children’s brands Experience with fashion or ecommerce content Experience with Runway AI, Kling, Pika or similar tools Experience with Meta Business Suite Experience creating TikTok, Instagram Reels or Meta ad creatives Brand Style: Organicline content should feel: Premium Soft Clean Warm Modern Natural Child-friendly Calm, but not boring Avoid loud colours, messy layouts, cheap templates, heavy effects or overdesigned graphics. The content should feel like a beautiful Australian children’s brand, not a random social media template. Quality Standards: I’m looking for someone who cares about the final result. Content must look premium. Text must be readable. Spelling must be checked. Video must not look lazy or random. AI clips must look natural. No strange motion, glitches or distorted children. No text covering a child’s face or important product detail. No public captions that sound like internal production notes. Every post must be checked before delivery because this is public brand content. Compensation: This is a small, clear, part-time weekly role. Paid test task: 15 USD Trial week: 50 USD After successful trial: 60 to 75 USD per week Organicline is still a growing brand. I’m looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person. As the brand grows, compensation may be reviewed in the future, based on consistency, quality, reliability and the level of content delivered. This role is for someone efficient. The weekly plan and materials are provided, so the work is mainly creative assembly, design, video editing and checking. Selection Process: Step 1: Send your application with portfolio examples. Step 2: Shortlisted applicants complete a small paid test task. Step 3: Best applicant completes a paid trial week. Step 4: Long-term weekly work begins if the trial goes well. The paid test task will ask you to create one outstanding 20 to 30 second vertical Reel from provided Organicline photos and assets. The goal is not just to animate a photo. The goal is to make the brand feel more alive, premium and scroll-stopping while keeping the product and child looking natural. Confidentiality And IP: Before receiving broader access to Organicline materials, the selected applicant will need to sign a simple Confidentiality and IP Agreement. All work created for Organicline will belong to Organicline. Organicline images, videos, children’s photos, product materials, brand documents and briefs must not be shared, reused or added to a portfolio without written permission. How To Apply: Please send: A short introduction about you. A link to your portfolio. At least 3 examples of short-form videos you created. At least 3 examples of Canva graphics, carousel designs or social media posts. Your experience with Canva. Your experience with Filmora, CapCut or similar video editing tools. Your experience with AI-assisted video tools, if any. How many hours you think you would need to complete the weekly package. The word “cotton” at the start of your message, so I know you read the full post. Please also answer these questions: What makes a children’s clothing brand look premium on Instagram? How would you turn simple product photos into a beautiful 20 to 30 second Reel? What would you do if a caption or text I gave you sounded too technical or not suitable for public posting? Applications without video examples will not be considered. I’m looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person.

description: We are looking for a Floating Layered Card Video Editor who can create fast-paced, visually rich explainer videos using the specific layered card style seen in the example videos below. DO NOT APPLY if you cannot replicate this exact style. Please watch the examples before applying. Example Videos (study these before applying): ---------- /watch?v=mezHN2-qmrs ---------- /watch?v=bBT3_Yq7mE0 ---------- /watch?v=sLVBFfObP_o What This Style Is: This is NOT traditional editing. It is a specific visual format where: -Floating rounded-card visuals — images, video clips, and diagrams appear as layered, rounded-corner cards over a clean neutral background (not raw fullscreen footage) -Multiple assets on screen simultaneously — diagrams, real photos, and footage are composed together in the same frame, not shown one at a time -Kinetic on-screen text — subtitles and key points are styled as bold caption overlays, timed to the voiceover -Clean, smooth transitions — card entries, exits, and scene changes must feel polished and intentional. Choppy or jarring cuts will kill viewer retention and are not acceptable -Fast but controlled pacing — cuts every 2–4 seconds, always serving the narration. No dead air, no slow sections -Sound design — subtle whooshes, pops, and background music that complement the visuals without overpowering the voiceover What You Will Do -Follow the Script: We provide the script, voiceover, and creative direction -Source Real Visuals: Find real photos, footage, diagrams, and stock visuals that match the content. No random filler stock footage. -Compose the Layered Scene: Build each scene using the floating card format — layering assets thoughtfully so the frame always looks intentional and clean -Keep Retention: You must understand pacing and viewer psychology. Every second must earn its place. If it's boring, cut it. -Music & Sound FX: Select background music that fits the tone and use sound effects to make card transitions feel satisfying and smooth Requirements: -Strong portfolio showing the floating layered card style specifically — general editing reels will not be considered -Able to deliver 3 videos per week -Works independently once workflow is established -Communicates clearly and meets deadlines Pay $15–$20 per video depending on complexity and quality. Room to grow for the right editor. BONUS & INCENTIVES for the right editor. How To Apply: -Start your message with the word FLOAT & (your name) -Send 1 video you edited that matches the floating layered card style. -Please expect a 1–2 minute sample test (script and voiceover provided)

title: Full-Time E-commerce Video Editor
description: About Us Cleriva is a fast growing e-commerce brand transforming respiratory wellness through innovative red light therapy solutions that ease congestion and elevate daily well-being. Creative thinking is at the heart of how we connect with our audience, and we constantly push to produce content that is fresh and engaging. We’re seeking a video editor who can bring original ideas to the table while delivering polished, high performing content. The ideal candidate is not only skilled and creative but also highly coachable, open to feedback, and eager to continue learning as our brand evolves What You’ll Do As a video editor, you’ll be at the center of our creative output, turning raw content and ideas into scroll stopping creatives and brand assets that drive real results. Your work will directly impact our revenue and brand presence across multiple platforms. Your responsibilities will include: - Creative Research & Inspiration - Regularly study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, and other platforms to spot trends, hooks, and editing techniques. - Bring new creative ideas to the team each week. New formats, transitions, captions, sound effects, and storytelling angles we haven’t tried yet. - Video Editing for Performance - Edit UGC style videos and direct-response ads for platforms like Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and content for our website. - Focus on performance-driven editing with strong hooks, optimized pacing, clear CTAs, and audience specific storytelling. - Adapt and version videos into multiple aspect ratios - Graphic Design Support - Use Canva (or similar tools) to create thumbnails, ad statics, and product imagery that match our brand identity. - Design on-screen text, callouts, and graphics that enhance clarity and drive engagement. - Creative Testing & Iteration - Work closely with the marketing team to understand performance data and make informed edits that improve CTR, view-through rate, and conversions. - Maintain a library of “winning” ad formats and help evolve them over time. - Collaboration & Feedback - Participate in creative meetings, pitch ideas, and refine concepts with the team. - Be open to feedback, ask questions when unclear, and apply learnings to future projects. - Speed & Efficiency - Manage deadlines without sacrificing quality. - Be proactive in spotting opportunities to improve workflows and creative output. What We’re Looking For - Proven experience editing for e-commerce brands (portfolio required: ads, demos, UGC, etc.) - Strong attention to detail, with a creative eye and excellent communication skills - Ability to follow direction precisely but also to bring ideas and refinements - Remote editing setup (computer, software, internet) - Bonus: Graphic design experience (especially in Canva or similar tools) - If you don’t have a proficient e-commerce editing background, we kindly ask that you pass on this opportunity. How We Hire - Submit your application (CV, portfolio, and your expected hourly rate or salary range) - If shortlisted, we’ll invite you to complete a paid test project. You’ll work with a provided script and instructions. - Compensation will honor your proposed rate. - Good creative instincts, clear communication, and a polished cut win the day. Compensation & Growth We believe in rewarding both quality of work and the measurable impact of your creative output. While exact base pay will be tailored to your experience, our structure is designed to be fair, transparent, and performance-driven. Project-Based Compensation Model: - On average, a completed one minute edited video is budgeted at approximately two hours of work, factoring in sourcing, editing, revisions, and delivery. - More complex projects such as those requiring advanced motion graphics, heavy compositing, or brand-level polish are compensated at a higher rate to reflect the additional time and skill involved. - Simple edits, such as minimal-adjustment UGC videos, are compensated proportionally while still ensuring fair pay for the time invested. - Performance Bonuses (ROAS-Based): - Bonuses are awarded only when a video meets or exceeds a set Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) threshold. - Bonuses are incremental, meaning the higher the ROAS, the greater the bonus amount. - Over time, these bonuses can significantly increase your earnings, with the potential to double your base salary if multiple videos consistently perform at high ROAS levels. Career Development & Growth: - Opportunities to take on higher level creative strategy, concept ownership, and leadership roles as the brand scales. - Access to creative tools, training resources, and ongoing mentorship to help you refine your skills and grow professionally. We look forward to seeing your work and possibly welcoming you to our creative team!

title: UX/Graphic Designer
description: Context Working across a diverse portfolio of client accounts, this role is the creative engine that transforms client business goals into functional, high-impact designs. Role Purpose The UX/Graphic Designer is responsible for conceptualising and executing design solutions that meet specific client briefs. You will balance the "look" (Graphic Design) with the "logic" (UX Design) to ensure that every asset -- whether a landing page, a social campaign, or a brand identity -- is optimised for the client’s target audience and business objectives.
