Quality Control: Ensuring all files are delivered to spec (print or digital) and maintaining organised asset libraries for every client. Efficiency: Managing time effectively across multiple projects, meeting all internal and client deadlines without compromising quality. Technical Accuracy: Minimal revisions required due to technical errors or failure to follow the creative brief. Collaboration: Seamless handoffs to the development team with clearly documented design systems and components. Skills and Requirements 2 to 4 years of experience in a design role, preferably within a fast-paced agency environment. Dual-Skill Mastery: A portfolio that shows a mix of beautiful graphic design (branding/layout) and smart UX thinking (user flows/prototypes). Software Proficiency: Advanced skills in Figma (or Adobe XD) and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). Adaptability: The ability to pivot between different industries and design styles quickly and effectively. Time Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects at once while staying organised and meeting deadlines. Communication: Comfortable presenting work to clients and taking constructive feedback with a professional, solution-oriented mindset.

title: Video Editor
description: We Don't Need a Video Editor. We Need a Performance Creative Machine Who Makes Ads That Print Money. Video Editor - Performance Creatives Most video editors make pretty videos. You'll make ads that stop the scroll and scale to millions in spend. About Rescale Media We're not just another e-commerce company. We're a brand incubator on a mission to build enduring, value-driven brands that bring meaningful products into families' lives. We've scaled from just drop shipping to a 30+ person team doing $1M+/month. Our goal? Multi 9-figures. And we're just getting started. ???? Learn more at ---------- dia Our Core Values GENIUSES & OWNERS We partner with builders who think like founders. Not employees waiting to be told what to do—owners who see a problem and fix it. ITERATIONS > HOURS We don't measure success by time at your desk. We measure it by how fast you can test, learn, and improve. Ship it. Learn. Repeat. TRUTH OVER EGO We prioritize honesty and clarity, even when it's uncomfortable. No politics. No BS. Just data and results. The Role You won't be making corporate videos or cinematic masterpieces. You'll be making ads that convert—fast-paced, scroll-stopping content that turns viewers into buyers. You'll work directly with our Creative Strategists who develop the concepts and hooks. Your job is to bring those concepts to life with edits that hit hard in the first second and keep people watching. We test a lot of creative. That means volume matters. You need to be fast without sacrificing quality—and smart enough to know which details matter and which don't. What You'll Do Edit direct response video ads for Meta, TikTok, and other platforms Transform raw UGC footage, b-roll, and assets into high-converting ads Execute on creative briefs from our Creative Strategists Produce multiple ad variations and iterations quickly Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and sound design Maintain organized project files and asset libraries Hit deadlines consistently—we move fast Learn from performance data and apply insights to future edits What We're Looking For 2+ years of video editing experience Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut Portfolio of direct response or social media ads you've edited Understanding of what makes content work on Meta/TikTok (pacing, hooks, trends) Ability to work fast without sacrificing quality Experience with motion graphics and text animation Strong attention to detail—audio sync, color, pacing all matter Bonus Points: Experience editing for DTC/e-commerce brands After Effects skills for motion graphics Understanding of direct response principles You've edited ads that actually scaled Experience with UGC-style content This Role Is NOT For... We're being direct because we respect your time: Editors who only know cinematic/narrative work Those who can't handle high volume and fast turnarounds Anyone who needs hand-holding on every edit People who take feedback personally instead of professionally Editors who think the algorithm is wrong when an ad doesn't perform Compensation & Benefits ???? Monthly Salary: $1,000/month Plus: Monthly performance bonuses tied to company Operating Profit (5-25% of salary) Quarterly profit pool distribution (2-7.5% of company profits shared among team) Remote-first environment Work with a team of A-players who actually give a damn Direct founder access—no layers of bureaucracy Real ownership of your domain—we don't micromanage Our Hiring Process We don't waste time—yours or ours. Here's how it works: Step 1: Application (You're here!) Step 2: Initial Interview with Founder Step 3: Internal Assessment by Rescale Step 4: WhatsApp update for next steps Step 5: Signing of Independent Contractor and NDA Step 6: Onboarding and Training Total timeline: 1 week from application to offer. Ready to Apply? [???? ---------- ] Complete the application form above. Be thorough—this is your first impression. P.S. Our best-performing ads aren't the most polished—they're the ones that hook in the first second and don't let go. If you understand why a rough UGC edit can outperform a cinematic masterpiece, we should talk. P.P.S. If you're reading this far, you're already more thorough than 90% of applicants. That's exactly who we want.

title: Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing
description: Senior Video Editor — Performance Marketing Company: Bublishing LLC / Ancient Remedies Team: Performance Creative Team Role Type: Full-time Experience Required: Minimum 5 years As a fast-growing natural health and wellness company, Ancient Remedies empowers people to take charge of their well-being through holistic medicine. We create beautifully crafted, practical books focusing on herbal remedies, food as medicine, and natural healing. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Video Editor to join our Performance Marketing team and help create high-performing ads for a fast-scaling DTC health and wellness brand. This is not a traditional video editing role. Can edit fast without becoming sloppy — speed and quality both matter here. We need someone who understands that performance editing is not just about making videos look good — it’s about creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly, build trust, and convert. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both traditional editing and AI-powered creative workflows. You should be comfortable working with AI-generated assets, organic footage, UGC-style content, and performance creative briefs. You should also understand pacing, retention, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and how editing decisions impact ad performance. This person will be one of the strongest editors on the team and will work closely with the Lead Video Editor to improve creative quality, support the editing team, organize tools/assets, and help raise the overall standard of performance creative production. Key Responsibilities Performance Video Editing • Edit high-converting ads for Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other paid social platforms. • Create performance-driven edits using a mix of AI-generated assets, UGC content, stock footage, motion graphics, voiceovers, and organic clips. • Build strong openings, scroll-stopping hooks, pattern interrupts, and retention-focused sequences. • Edit with a deep understanding of pacing, clarity, emotional pull, and conversion intent. • Adapt edits based on creative strategy, ad performance, and feedback from Creative Strategists and Media Buyers. • Produce multiple variations and iterations of winning ads quickly. AI-Powered Editing & Creative Workflows • Use AI tools to create, enhance, and iterate video assets. • Work with tools such as VEO3, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Seedance, Runway, Kling AI, and similar AI video/audio platforms. • Create realistic AI-driven video outputs with attention to natural lip sync, voice matching, facial expressions, and believable human-like performances. • Use prompting techniques to generate stronger AI assets, scenes, voices, characters, and visual sequences. • Stay updated on the latest AI video tools, trends, workflows, and viral content formats. • Help the team improve AI-assisted production speed and quality. Creative Quality & Performance Standards • Understand what makes an ad perform from an editing perspective. • Analyze winning ads and apply creative insights into future edits. • Identify what editing patterns, hooks, pacing, and formats are working. • Help improve the quality and consistency of creative output across the team. • Ensure videos are clear, polished, platform-native, and aligned with performance goals. • Maintain fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality. Team Support & Leadership • Work closely with the Lead Video Editor to support the performance editing team. • Help mentor, guide, and provide feedback to junior/mid-level editors when needed. • Support quality control across edits before they move forward. • Help organize tools, workflows, assets, references, and editing resources. • Assist in improving editing processes, creative standards, and team efficiency. • Act as a strong senior presence within the editing team. Technical Requirements • Minimum 5 years of professional video editing experience. • Advanced proficiency in performance video editing for paid social ads. • Strong experience with AI-powered video creation and editing workflows. • Fast editing speed is required. This role requires someone who can move quickly, produce high-quality edits under tight timelines, and keep up with a high-volume performance marketing environment. • Hands-on experience with tools such as: - VEO3 - HeyGen - ElevenLabs - Seedance - Runway - Kling AI - or similar AI video/audio tools • Strong understanding of: - AI prompting - natural lip sync - voice cloning - facial expressions - realistic AI human performances - AI-generated scenes and characters • Strong understanding of: - retention editing - pacing - scroll-stopping hooks - pattern interrupts - engagement-driven storytelling - direct-response editing • Experience editing short-form ads for: - Facebook - Instagram Reels - TikTok - YouTube Shorts • Ability to work with both AI-generated and organic assets. • Ability to deliver high-quality edits quickly and consistently. Preferred Qualifications • Experience working in performance marketing, DTC, e-commerce, supplements, health/wellness, or direct-response advertising. • Experience managing, mentoring, or supporting a team of editors. • Experience analyzing winning ads and translating insights into stronger edits. • Strong understanding of creative testing and iteration. • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with Creative Strategists, Media Buyers, and other editors. • Highly proactive, accountable, organized, and detail-oriented. • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume creative environment. • Strong taste level and ability to balance performance with quality. What Success Looks Like A successful Senior Video Editor will: • Consistently produce high-performing video ads. • Improve the quality and speed of the editing team. • Help turn creative briefs into polished, conversion-focused ads. • Use AI tools effectively to increase production speed and creative possibilities. • Understand why certain ads win and apply those learnings to future edits. • Help the Lead Video Editor maintain high standards across the team. • Contribute to a stronger, faster, and more scalable creative production system. Who This Role Is For This role is for someone who is not just a “good editor,” but someone who understands how editing directly impacts ad performance. You should be someone who: • Cares about results, not just aesthetics. • Can move fast without being sloppy. • Has strong creative instincts. • Knows how to use AI tools effectively. • Can take feedback without ego. • Can help raise the standard of the team. • Wants to be part of a high-performing creative engine. Who This Role Is Not For This role is not for someone who: • Only edits long-form content or brand videos. • Struggles to keep up with fast turnaround times or needs too much time to complete standard performance ad edits. • Needs constant direction for every small decision. • Is not comfortable using AI tools. • Does not understand paid social ads. • Prioritizes aesthetics over performance. • Struggles with fast turnaround times. • Avoids feedback or iteration. • Cannot work in a high-volume creative environment. Application Requirements Please include: • Portfolio or reel of relevant video editing work. • Examples of short-form ads or paid social creatives. • Examples of AI-assisted video work, if available. • A brief note on your experience with AI video tools and performance marketing edits. Optional Trial Task Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid trial task to evaluate: • Editing quality • Performance creative instincts • AI workflow capability • Speed and communication • Ability to follow a creative brief Please submit your application at zurl.to/j6So?source=CareerSite.

title: Video Editor - VA
description: If you've been looking for a long-term role with a fast-growing US brand in the masculine wellness space, read carefully. Joburn and our team has generated over seven million dollars for clients in the past couple of years. We're just getting started. Now we're placing trained operators into the brands we know best — and this is one of those roles. THE BRAND: BEEFCAKE WELLNESS Brandon Bohonko runs Beefcake Wellness. 100,000+ followers across Instagram and TikTok. He gained 70 lbs on purpose to understand what his clients were going through, then started losing it publicly. He documents the whole arc. Posts 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week. The audience is fitness-curious men 25-45 who know what to do and aren't doing it. The brand voice is loose, masculine, lightly profane, period-driven. Lowercase captions. Self-aware. Anti-hype. Think Sam Sulek + Greg Doucette's editing style. Fast cuts, on-screen text that does the work the voice doesn't, music that drives pacing. If you don't already get this register, watch 10 videos ---------- ---------- before applying. WHAT YOU'LL DO Edit 5-6 short-form vertical videos per week (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) 60-90 seconds per video typically Add cuts, b-roll overlays, on-screen text, music, captions Match Brandon's visual style. You'll get a 20-video reference set plus a style guide. Repurpose long-form podcast or interview footage into 3-5 shorts per session Manage a simple weekly Trello or Notion board of pending vs shipped 48-hour standard turnaround on regular edits, 24-hour on priority You're embedded directly with Brandon's content operation. Not subcontracted. Not white-labeled. You are his editor, daily. REQUIRED 2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social platforms CapCut Pro fluency. Brandon edits rough on iPhone, you finish on desktop. Adobe Premiere Pro OR DaVinci Resolve at an intermediate level Native or near-native English. You'll write on-screen text and clean captions. Stable internet, GMT+8 hours or compatible overlap with Pacific or Mountain time Hook-first editing instinct. The first 1.5 seconds is the entire game. Ability to take a 1-paragraph brief plus raw footage and produce a publishable edit NICE TO HAVE Thumbnail design for YouTube Familiarity with fitness or bodybuilding content Comfortable with profanity and irreverent humor (this IS the brand voice) Loom recording for async feedback exchange WHO WE WANT (AND WHO WE DON'T) We hire on three things. Read these honestly. If they don't sound like you, don't apply. We'd rather you save the time. 1. Radical candor. We tell you when something is off. We expect you to tell us back. No sugar-coating. No "great question!" energy. We just talk. If you need a soft work culture, this isn't it. 2. Extreme ownership. Your edit shipped late? That's on you. The brief was unclear? You should have asked. The team will not hand-hold. The good news: when something works, the credit is also yours. 3. Willingness to move. Speed beats prestige. 10 cuts in 48 hours beats one perfect edit in two weeks. If you need to polish something for a week before shipping, you'll be miserable here. And one more thing. The honest reason we're hiring this way. AI is coming for video editing. Not slowly. We see it. The editors who survive the next 18 months will be the ones who use AI as a leverage tool but keep their own taste on top. The ones who don't will be replaced. We want to help you survive that. This role isn't just an editing job. It's training to become an AI-augmented operator. We pay for the work. The skill upgrade is a side effect of how we work. PAY $3/hr × 40 hrs/wk = $480/mo to start. Rate reviews are based on performance, reliability, and the brand's growth. No specific bumps promised. Strong editors who fit the team can grow with the brand over time. Piece-rate option also on the table for the right person. One last thing before the apply step. Brandon's a fitness guy. He likes seeing what people actually eat. Put your favorite food in the subject line of your reply. Catches the people who read carefully too. HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the only application we review): Reply to this post. We personally watch every reply. In your reply, include: Your portfolio. Links to 5 short-form videos you've edited (Reels, TikToks, Shorts). A 60-second Loom introducing yourself and explaining why this specific brand interests you. One specific video ---------- ---------- you'd improve, and how. We're looking to make this hire within 5 business days. If we move forward with you, we'll be in touch fast. Not looking for a one-project freelancer. Looking for an editor who grows with this brand for 12-24 months minimum. — Cyborg Talent (Joburn) on behalf of Beefcake Wellness

description: Company: MORPHOS | Full-Service Creative Agency Role Type: Part-time to start, growing into full-time Schedule: Your choice | 8am–5pm Philippine time OR 8am–5pm PST, Monday–Friday Rate: $8–$12/hour USD, based on skill and experience Software: Adobe Premiere Pro (primary) --- Read this before you apply: Most agencies hire editors to push buttons. We don't. MORPHOS is a creative-first, AI-second agency. That means we lead with taste, craft, and creative authority and we use AI to move faster, not to replace the human eye behind the work. If you're the kind of editor who actually cares about the why behind a cut, the rhythm of a hook, or whether a piece of typography earns its place on the screen, keep reading. This is a junior editor role with a real senior-editor path. I'm a video editor and creative director myself, so early on you won't be expected to carry the full creative load. What I need right now is a sharp, fast, technically clean executor who can take direction, deliver revisions with precision, and grow into someone I trust to make creative calls without me in the room. If that growth path matters to you, we're aligned. --- What you'll be editing · Primarily Instagram Reels --- short-form, vertical, cinematic · Some YouTube content over time as the role expands · Footage is shot intentionally --- often 4K, often cinematic, often LUT-graded · You'll be working with footage from MORPHOS itself and from our clients (notably an aesthetics and wellness brand with a strong visual identity) --- What I need from you (Requirements) Technical Skills: · Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro (other editing software is acceptable as long as you can render to spec and collaborate cleanly) · Strong typography sensibility --- captions, kinetic text, and on-screen titles should feel intentional, readable, and never overwhelming. Sometimes simple captions. Sometimes animated text. You should know the difference. · Speed with quality. I don't want fast and sloppy. I don't want slow and precious. I want efficient and excellent. · Comfortable receiving and executing revisions with high accuracy --- Communication · Strong written and spoken English. You need to understand feedback the first time, ask sharp questions when something's unclear, and communicate proactively when something's blocking you. · Take feedback with humility and accuracy. Humility without accuracy means we redo the same revision twice. Accuracy without humility means we fight about taste. I want both. ? Setup · Internet speed: minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload. Faster is better. You'll be pulling down multi-gigabyte files regularly? sometimes hundreds of gigabytes in a working week. · Hard drive space: you need enough free space to handle 4K footage from day one. I'll cover a dedicated external drive for you within the first few weeks of hiring, but you need to be able to work with the footage we send during the trial and onboarding period. · A computer that can actually edit 4K without crashing every twenty minutes --- Bonus skills (not required, but they'll move you up the list) · Color correction and grading proficiency · Experience working with LUTs on cinematic 4K footage · Working knowledge of other Adobe Suite tools --- After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom · Graphic design skills or instincts (we're a full-service shop, and editors who can think visually beyond the timeline grow fastest here) · Familiarity with motion graphics or template-based animation --- Compensation & Growth · Starting rate: $8–$12/hour USD, based on demonstrated skill and experience · A paid trial edit is part of the hiring process --- you'll be compensated for your time whether or not we move forward together · External hard drive provided once we commit to working together long-term · Rate increases tied to loyalty, output quality, and growth into senior responsibilities · My goal is to pay above industry standard for the right person --- but I need to see proof in the pudding first. Loyalty and consistency over time unlock the ceiling. I'm not looking for a quick hire. I'm looking for someone who wants to be here in two years. --- Schedule (your choice) I believe in work-life balance. I know night shifts are common for Philippine VAs, but they're hard on your health long-term, so I'm giving you the choice: Option A: 8am–5pm Philippine Standard Time, Monday–Friday Option B: 8am–5pm Pacific Standard Time, Monday–Friday Whichever serves your life better. Pick the one you can sustain. --- How to apply Send the following --- and please follow the format, because attention to instructions is part of the evaluation: · A short intro --- who you are, where you're based, why this role caught your eye (a paragraph, not an essay) · A portfolio link --- Google Drive, Vimeo, YouTube, or a personal site. I want to see at least 3 recent short-form vertical edits (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts) you've actually edited. I recommend you only send 3-5 videos of your best work. · Your editing software of choice and your years of experience with it · Your internet speed test result (screenshot from speedtest.net is fine) · Which schedule (Option A or B) you're applying for · Your hourly rate expectation within the $8–$12 range, and one sentence on why you land where you land Top applicants will receive a paid trial edit using real footage from our pipeline. The trial is paid regardless of outcome. --- A final note If you want a job where you clock in, push the right buttons, and clock out...this isn't it. If you want to grow inside a creative agency that takes craft seriously, uses AI as a tool not a crutch, and actually pays you what you're worth as you level up --- apply. I'm looking forward to seeing your work. Caleb Founder & Creative Director, MORPHOS

What We're Looking For: - 2+ years of hands-on Shopify experience — not just browsing the admin, but actually building promotions, scheduling sales, configuring discount apps, and updating site content. - Working knowledge of Klaviyo — comfortable editing forms, popups, and capture flows without breaking things. - Solid Canva skills — you can take a brand template and produce clean, on-brand promotional graphics. We scaled from $0 to $60K days in 3 weeks and we're on pace for multiple 8 figures this year. That's just the starting line. Our vision is to build a household supplement brand that sits in retail stores alongside the biggest names in the category. YOUR MISSION Your mission is to produce high-converting direct response video ads at speed and at a standard that moves product. You will execute against proven scripts and frameworks, bring sharp editing instincts to every cut, and own the quality of every video that leaves your queue. The best editors here don't just edit, they think like marketers. RESPONSIBILITIES - Produce 2+ minute of high-quality direct response video ads per day following provided scripts and style guides - Edit AI avatar videos that look smooth, realistic, and on-brand — this is a core function of the role - Source and place B-roll and supporting footage that enhances copy lines and drives viewer action - Apply direct response principles when reviewing scripts — you understand what makes people buy - Operate with high autonomy, managing your daily queue efficiently without hand-holding - Stay ahead of new AI tools and editing techniques as the landscape evolves - Ensure every video meets our quality standards and matches provided instructions first time - As a foundational tea ---------- mber, help establish editing standards and onboard future editors as we scale OUR TECH STACK - Video Editing: CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro - AI Avatar & Generation: HeyGen, Google Flow, Hedra - Voiceover: ElevenLabs - Image Generation: Midjourney, Krea - Communication: Slack KPIs YOU WILL OWN - Daily Output: 2+ minutes of video edits per day, 10+ minutes per week - Revision Rate: No more than 2 rounds of revisions per video WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven direct response video editing experience at a brand doing $10M+ per year — non-negotiable - Strong AI avatar creation — HeyGen or equivalent, smooth and realistic output required - Proficiency in CapCut Pro or Premiere Pro - Experience in health, wellness, or supplements is a strong plus - Deep understanding of DR principles — hooks, pacing, retention, and what drives conversions - High autonomy operator who manages output and meets deadlines without being managed - Strong written English for communication and script review - Genuinely obsessed with creative performance, not just creative craft WHY JOIN JFM VENTURES - Performance bonuses for winning creatives — when your ads convert, you get paid for it - High impact work — your edits run on real spend and reach real buyers every single day - Direct line to founders & creative strategists — no layers, no politics - Early tea ---------- mber advantage — top performers will be given opportunities to lead and grow - Fully remote — we measure output, not hours - Fast-moving environment — we scaled from zero to $60K days in three weeks, the pace is real THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF - You need constant direction to stay productive - You're a perfectionist who loses hours on a single transition — speed and quality both matter here - You're uncomfortable with tools and formats changing fast — our environment shifts and you have to move with it - You don't have real direct response experience — brand videos and social content is not the same - You see this as a freelance side project — this is full-time and we need full commitment - Paid media and DR marketing doesn't genuinely excite you — if it's just a job, this isn't the right fit HOW TO APPLY - If you're an elite direct response video editor who understands that every frame exists to drive a conversion, we want to hear from you. Fill out the full application below. We review every application personally and if there's a fit, we'll be in touch shortly. Looking forward to speaking soon! Google Form: ----------

description: I am looking for a reliable YouTube video editor for 3 faceless YouTube channels. The editor must be able to study each channel carefully and match the pacing, visuals, sound design, storytelling style, and overall editing feel. This is a long-term position for the right person. Channels / Editing Styles: Channel 1 – Australia Knows Reference: ---------- Style: Australian documentary/commentary style. Topics include cost of living, regional towns, retirement, and everyday changes happening across Australia. Editing should feel serious, nostalgic, documentary-style, and easy to follow. Use relevant Australian visuals, maps, town footage, old/new comparison images, subtle text, and clean pacing. Channel 2 – Senior Health / Wellness Style Reference: ---------- Style: Calm senior wellness content. Topics include healthy aging, simple habits, food, lifestyle, and general wellness information for older viewers. Editing should feel trustworthy, warm, clean, and not too fast. Use calm B-roll, readable text, gentle transitions, soft music, and visuals that older viewers can easily understand. Channel 3 – Australian Gardening / Grandma Style Reference: ---------- Style: Long-form gardening content for older Australian viewers. Topics include old-fashioned gardening tips, budget gardening, natural garden reuse, and traditional garden knowledge. Editing should feel warm, nostalgic, practical, and relaxing. Responsibilities: - Edit full YouTube videos based on voiceover and script - Match the editing style of each reference channel - Add suitable stock footage, images, music, sound effects, transitions, captions/text, and visual effects where needed - Keep the pacing engaging but suitable for older audiences - Use clear, readable text on screen - Maintain good viewer retention - Deliver videos on time - Communicate clearly and respond quickly - Be open to revisions and feedback Requirements: - Experience editing faceless YouTube videos - Experience with documentary, senior, health/wellness, gardening, or storytelling-style videos is preferred - Good understanding of pacing, visual flow, B-roll selection, and sound design - Ability to follow reference channels closely - Reliable internet connection - Fast response time - Ability to meet deadlines - Must be detail-oriented and willing to improve Pay: The starting rate is $10 USD per video. Generate the YouTube DESCRIPTION with ChatGPT (free version) using the prompt we provide — just replace the title. 6. Upload to YouTube (we give you Editor permissions on the channel): - Title, description (+ link to the latest video of the channel), thumbnail. - "Altered content: Yes" + "Not for kids". - Install and use the NextLev Chrome extension to insert ads every 30 seconds with automatic ad breaks. - End screens: latest video + best option for viewer + subscribe. - Schedule at the exact DATE and TIME we indicate (always Spain peninsular time — adapt if you're in another timezone). 7. title: Performance Video Editor

You'll sit at the intersection of creative and conversion, cutting video that stops thumbs mid-scroll, drives new customer acquisition and helps us achieve our mission of becoming the experts in the window furnishings industry. You'll craft openings that earn the next 30 seconds - **Rapidly iterate and A/B test** design concepts based on performance data and real-time campaign feedback - **Design scroll-stopping videos and motion graphics** that capture attention within 3 seconds and drive engagement - **Participate in creative reviews** to analyse top-performing creative elements and extract replicable design principles - **Multiply creative output through AI tools** — Leverage cutting-edge AI Technologies to enhance asset generation and production efficiency - **Meet performance benchmarks** including click-through rates, engagement rates, and conversion metrics across all campaigns - **Deliver assets on deadline** while maintaining quality standards and organised documentation systems --- ### **What Sets You Apart** - **Proven experience** — Minimum of 2-3 years in a similar role. You've got a strong grasp of design fundamentals and know your way around Adobe Creative Cloud. - **You analyse data before designing** — You don't just want to know what looks good; you want to know what converts and why - **You've mastered rapid iteration** — You can produce multiple high-quality variants quickly, not precious about your work - **You understand the psychology behind conversions** — You know why certain visuals trigger action and how to implement those principles - **You can translate performance metrics into design decisions** — CTR, Hook Rate & CVR aren't just acronyms to you; they're design briefs - **You think like a growth marketer, not just a designer** — You care about business outcomes, not just aesthetics - **You make decisions fast** — You're comfortable with speed, can manage multiple projects, and deliver quality under tight deadlines --- ### **Why Join Us** - **Real ownership of a fast-growing brand** — your edits will be seen by hundreds of thousands of Australians every week, and you'll see the revenue impact in real time - **Work with purpose, Ideas become reality** — Create assets that drive real business results. Focus on results, not desk time, with freedom to structure your day (with core collaboration hours). - **Supportive team culture full of A-players** — Our rigorous hiring ensures everyone on the team is exceptional while ensuring we win as a team. - **Performance-based rewards** — We recognise and compensate exceptional results - **Growth opportunity, Collaborative environment** — Help shape our creative approach as we expand. Knowledge sharing without creative politics or egos. --- ### **Ready to Prove You're in the Top 1%?** Our hiring process is built to identify exceptional talent — quickly. 1. Apply with your resume and a portfolio/reel of performance work (please link to the actual ads, not just brand films) 2. Shortlisted applicants complete an un-paid trial performance editing project using real 5 Minute Blinds footage & creative brief 3. Finalists join us for a portfolio review and creative strategy discussion **Applications without the completed project will not be considered.** This is intentional we're hiring on output, not credentials.

title: WANTED! The Worlds Fastest Ad Video Editor
job_title: WANTED! The Worlds Fastest Ad Video Editor
description: When you apply, please make sure the subject line of your reply is: "I actually read the instructions" ---------------------------------------- WHO WE ARE We're DTC LABS — a small startup team with serious experience and drive in e-commerce, paid media, and physical products. We used to operate as a holding company with multiple brands. Now we're laser-focused on a single brand and we're scaling it to $100M over the next few years. You'll work directly with the founders. No middle managers, no waiting on permission. Just briefs, edits, feedback, and ship. ---------------------------------------- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Someone who's fast, detail-obsessed, and eager to learn. You take feedback without flinching and apply it the same day. You adapt quickly — we're constantly testing new AI tools and the editors who win here are the ones who pick them up fastest. Speed matters, but sloppy doesn't ship. ---------------------------------------- KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Edit 3-4 short-form UGC-style ads per day (15-90 sec) for Meta and TikTok - Edit 1 long-form video (VSL, infomercial, testimonial — 3-7 min) every 2-3 days - Source supporting clips from TikTok, YouTube, and stock libraries - Use the latest AI tools (we'll provide training — we're at the edge of what AI can do for editing) - Implement revision feedback within the same day - Track your work in Notion and upload finals to ---------- c using our naming convention ---------------------------------------- QUALIFICATIONS - Proficient in Premiere Pro and CapCut (we use CapCut across the company) - 2+ years editing experience, ideally with paid social - Strong written English - Portfolio showing UGC-style ads OR long-form VSLs (ideally both) - Available for 3-hour daily overlap with 15:00-18:00 Europe/Athens time ---------------------------------------- COMPENSATION AND GROWTH Base: Starting from $1,300 USD/month (40 hrs/week) Bonuses: Down the line, $500+/month in performance bonuses for ads that hit KPIs Growth path: - Top performers grow into senior and lead roles as the company scales - We promote from within. Always. ---------------------------------------- SUCCESSFUL VIDEO EDITOR PERSONALITY PROFILE You care more about whether the ad converts than whether it wins a design award. You break your head brainstorming hooks that force people to stop scrolling — not the lazy kind, the kind that actually work. You take blunt feedback without flinching, ship fast, and iterate faster. Tight deadlines energize you instead of stressing you out. ---------------------------------------- MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH... - Remote working: This is a remote (work-from-home) position. If you don't have a quiet environment with reliable power and internet, this isn't the right role. - 30-day trial period: All offers start with a 30-day trial. If you're in a comfortable job, don't quit unless you're confident in your ability to perform. - Fast revision cycles: Sometimes 3 rounds in a day. Constructive feedback comes directly and quickly. - Output-only environment: We don't care about hours — we care about output. This is a demanding environment where what you ship is what counts. - Camera on for our weekly call. ---------------------------------------- OUR VALUES 1. COMMUNICATION AND FEEDBACK Clear and fast. You implement specific feedback within hours, not days. We don't bury problems; we surface them. 2. SPEED Deadlines are tight, priorities shift, urgency is the default. We'd rather ship and iterate than polish and miss the window — but speed without craft is just sloppy, and sloppy doesn't ship. 3. PERFORMANCE Aesthetics don't pay; conversions do. Every cut is a decision in service of a metric. ---------------------------------------- TO APPLY Reply to this job post with ALL of the following: 1. Subject line of your reply must be exactly: "I actually read the instructions" 2. A link to your resume as a PDF, named exactly: Lastname.Firstname.VideoEditor.pdf (Example: Smith.John.VideoEditor.pdf — host it on Google Drive, Dropbox, or similar, and paste the link.) 3. A link to your portfolio (3-5 best ad-style edits, ideally DTC or UGC). 4. Your favorite ad you've ever edited. Paste the link and write 2-3 sentences explaining why it worked. Take your time. Applications that skip any of the 4 items above will not be reviewed. ---------------------------------------- CLOSE We're building something rare here — a small team punching way above its weight, with a real shot at building one of the next big DTC brands. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we want to hear from you. If something about the role or the instructions doesn't make sense, include your question with your application. George

Your job is to find every drop-off point in the funnel — from ad click to booked appointment — and systematically test, optimize, and lift conversion at every stage. You'll be working on landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, booking flows, and the entire user journey from cold traffic to scheduled in-home consultation. description: --- **Video Editor — Documentary & Recurring Social Series | Laughing Man Studios** *Remote | Philippines | Part-time to start, with a clear path to full-time* **About us** Laughing Man is a fair-trade coffee brand and creative studio based in TriBeCa, New York City. Our studio produces documentary work and recurring social series rooted in our neighborhood, our farming partners in Ethiopia and Colombia, and the characters who make TriBeCa what it is. We're looking for editors who think like storytellers. **The role** This job is for someone who hears a story in raw footage before they touch a single cut. You'll edit documentary-style pieces—character profiles, place-based mini-docs, origin stories from our coffee farms—and you'll shape the recurring series that anchor our social channels week after week. Episode one needs to feel like a promise. Episode twenty needs to still feel fresh, but unmistakably part of the same world. **What you'll edit** - Documentary shorts and mini-episodes—character-driven, place-driven, emotionally honest - Recurring social series across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including pieces like *Faces of TriBeCa* (small business profiles), *Tribeca Tapes* (hidden neighborhood histories), and *It's About Time* (street interviews built around a 100-year-old sidewalk clock) - Long-form interview and live show content cut into episodic releases - Recurring formats that need a consistent visual and editorial signature so audiences recognize them at a glance **What we mean by "strong storytelling"** - You can find the spine of a story in a messy interview transcript and an hour of B-roll - You know when to hold a beat, when to cut on a breath, when to let silence do the work - You understand that pacing is meaning—the same footage cut two different ways tells two different stories, and you choose deliberately - You build cold opens that earn the watch and endings that land - You think in series, not just episodes—reusable opens, recurring motifs, a visual grammar that compounds over time - You treat real people on screen with care **What we're looking for** - A portfolio with real documentary or narrative work—character profiles, mini-docs, interview-based pieces, branded documentary, or a recurring series you helped shape. This is required. Polished commercial reels alone won't tell us what we need to know. - Demonstrated experience editing recurring series where consistency and identity matter - Strong command of an editing suite (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or similar). Bonus: Descript, color grading chops, sound design instincts. - A working understanding of how documentary storytelling translates to TikTok, Reels, and YouTube—each platform takes a different cut, even from the same story - Reliable remote communication and the ability to hit deadlines across time zones - English proficiency strong enough to work with transcripts, write captions, and collaborate closely with our New York team **Why this is worth your time** We're a small studio with a growing slate and a real point of view. We're hiring with growth in mind—this starts as project or part-time work so we can find the right fit on both sides, with a clear path to full-time as our content operation scales. The work is meaningful, the stories are real, and the people you'll be cutting are worth doing right by. **How to apply** Send us (1) your portfolio—please specify which pieces you edited and what your role was on each, (2) a short note on a documentary or series cut you're proud of and why, and (3) the editing software you work in. Our brand is professional, warm, and aspirational — and our videos need to reflect that at the highest level. thirds, and text overlays that are visually stunning — not generic templates Incorporating music, sound design, and audio mixing that makes the video feel professional and exciting Color grading footage to a consistent, premium aesthetic that matches our luxury brand Creating motion graphics, animated transitions, and visual effects that elevate the content above standard real estate videos Using AI video tools, AI-enhanced graphics, or generative effects where appropriate to create genuinely wow-worthy ---------- nts Cutting talking-head content in a dynamic way — removing dead air, adding B-roll cutaways, keeping energy high throughout Delivering files optimized for each platform — correct aspect ratios, captions, thumbnail suggestions Accepting revision requests professionally and turning around changes quickly Occasionally creating simple thumbnail graphics or cover images for YouTube and social media What We Are Looking For A strong portfolio of short-form video edits — specifically Reels, Shorts, or TikTok content — that demonstrate genuine creativity and technical skill Proficiency in professional editing software — Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent Experience with motion graphics tools — After Effects, CapCut Pro, or similar Knowledge of AI video tools, AI-enhanced visuals, or generative content is a significant advantage — we want someone who is staying current with what is possible Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, and storytelling — you understand what makes someone keep watching versus scroll away Understanding of social media platform requirements — aspect ratios, caption placement, hook-based editing structure Real estate, luxury lifestyle, or property video experience is a plus but not required Reliable, responsive, and able to meet agreed turnaround times consistently Proactive creative input — we want someone who brings ideas, not just executes instructions What Makes This Role Special We are not looking for someone to churn out average content. We are building a brand that stands out in the Palm Beach County luxury real estate market and we need a video editor who takes genuine pride in making something extraordinary. If you are the kind of editor who gets excited about a great color grade, a perfectly timed cut, or a title animation that stops someone mid-scroll — this is your role. We are also a growing brand which means this relationship has real long-term potential. Compensation $200 per month — flat rate regardless of exact hours Fully remote — work from anywhere Flexible schedule — you manage your own time, we manage the deadline Potential for increased budget as the relationship grows and results are proven We review every application and respond to serious candidates personally. Please do not apply if you cannot show us actual examples of your work — a portfolio is required.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)
job_title: Short-Form Video Editor (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)
description: Latest Free Stuff is one of the UK’s largest money-saving websites, helping millions of people discover free samples, competitions, giveaways, and money-saving opportunities. We’ve been featured on BBC Dragons’ Den and reach over 1 million monthly visitors through our website, email newsletters, app, and social channels. We’re looking for a talented Short-Form Video Editor to help us create engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts. This is a long-term opportunity with significant room for growth and responsibility. THE ROLE We are looking for a highly skilled video editor who can transform articles, screenshots, images, raw footage, and ideas into engaging short-form videos that capture attention and keep people watching. You should be comfortable using both traditional editing software and modern AI tools to create high-quality content efficiently. This role is primarily focused on video editing rather than content planning or social media management. Applications will be assessed primarily on the editing test rather than CVs or previous experience. We are looking for the best editor, regardless of formal qualifications. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Video Editing * Create engaging short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts. * Turn articles, screenshots, images, offers, and raw content into engaging videos. * Add captions, motion graphics, sound effects, transitions, music, stock footage, B-roll, and animations. * Create strong hooks designed to maximise viewer retention. * Repurpose content into multiple formats for different platforms. * Maintain consistent editing styles and branding. * Organise project files and meet deadlines. AI-Powered Editing * Use AI video editing tools to improve editing speed and quality. * Use AI voice generation tools to create narration and voiceovers where appropriate. * Use AI tools to generate captions, scripts, visual assets, and audio. * Research and test new AI tools that improve editing workflows. * Help automate repetitive editing tasks where possible. Publishing Support * Upload completed videos to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook , and YouTube. * Write titles, captions, and descriptions. * Create thumbnails. * Ensure videos are correctly formatted for each platform. * Schedule content according to publishing instructions. REQUIREMENTS * Proven video editing experience. * Strong portfolio of TikTok, Reels, or Shorts content. * Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software. * Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, CapCut AI, ElevenLabs, Descript, Runway, Veo, HeyGen, Synthesia, or similar. * Comfortable creating AI-generated voiceovers and audio content. * Strong understanding of short-form content and audience retention. * Excellent English comprehension. * Strong attention to detail. * Ability to work independently. * Reliable internet connection and computer. NICE TO HAVE * Motion graphics experience. * Thumbnail creation experience. * Experience creating content for consumer brands. * Familiarity with affiliate marketing, e-commerce, competitions, freebies, or digital media. SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE After 90 days, you will: * Consistently create high-quality short-form videos. * Deliver content with minimal revisions. * Understand our preferred editing style and audience. * Produce content efficiently using AI-assisted workflows. * Help increase the volume and quality of content published each week. COMPENSATION Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. This is a long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance. TO APPLY 1) Send your CV. 2) Send 3 examples of your BEST short-form video edits. Please include links and explain what parts of the editing you completed yourself. 3) Complete the Editing Test Please create a short-form video (30–60 seconds) based on the following article: Title of article - Ultimate List Of Free Birthday Stuff for 2026 Link to article - ---------- The objective is to create a highly engaging video suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Imagine your goal is to maximise: * Views * Watch time * Likes * Comments * Shares * Followers We are deliberately providing minimal instructions because we want to see your creativity, judgement, editing ability, use of AI tools, and understanding of what makes engaging short-form content. You may use: * AI tools * AI voiceovers * Stock footage * Motion graphics * Music * Sound effects * Screenshots * Animations * Any editing software you prefer Please submit: * Any video format (MP4 file, AVI, MOV etc) * Please upload to a Google drive, OneDrive etc (please make sure the file is public) 4) Final question How many 30–60 second short-form videos can you realistically create in a typical 8-hour working day while maintaining quality? Please submit your application with: * CV * Portfolio links * Expected monthly salary * A Google Drive or OneDrive folder containing your completed editing test * Answer to the productivity question Please include the word “PINEAPPLE” in your application so we know you’ve read the full job description.

title: Social Content Editor & Podcast Coordinator
description: DR. SOMI JAVAID Social Content Editor & Podcast Coordinator Remote   |   Part Time   |   20 hrs/week   |   Immediate Start 01  |  WHO WE ARE Dr. Somi Javaid is a board-certified OBGYN, founder, Webby Award-winning podcast host, keynote speaker, and women’s health advocate with 20 years of clinical experience. She is the host of DisruptHER — a Webby Award-winning podcast — and a recognized voice in women’s hormonal health, menopause, and sexual healthcare. She has raised $40 million as a minority founder, built and sold multiple companies, spoken on stages around the world, and is currently building one of the most important voices in women’s healthcare on social media. Her mission: to give women the clinical truth about their bodies that the healthcare system does not have time to provide. Her platforms: ---------- — 25K), TikTok (2K and growing fast), YouTube, LinkedIn (8K), and the DisruptHER podcast. 02  |  THE ROLE We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Social Content Editor & Podcast Coordinator to run the operational side of Dr. Javaid’s content machine across content editing, podcast production, email marketing, branded design, and day-to-day executive support. Dr. Javaid creates the content. You shape it, package it, and hand it to her PR team ready to publish — then keep her calendar, inbox, and content library running so the logistics never reach her desk. She films. You edit, package, organize, and coordinate. She shows up to respond to her audience. You handle the rest. This is a part-time remote role requiring approximately 20 hours per week. You will work independently with clear written guidelines, a detailed content calendar, and a brand playbook that tells you exactly what to do and when. 03  |  RESPONSIBILITIES Social Content & Editing (Primary responsibility — 40% of your time) Edit videos for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube using brand voice guidelines and templates provided Add hashtags from approved stacks for each platform Reformat Instagram Reels for TikTok — update text overlays, captions, and CTAs Package and hand finalized content to the PR team on schedule — correct platform, correct format, no delays (the PR team handles all scheduling and publishing) Add videos that align to the podcast episodes and shorts that are posted to youtube with the podcast production team Send Dr. Javaid a weekly content queue for approval every Wednesday morning Track basic performance metrics weekly — views, follows, saves, shares — and flag top performers Podcast Administration (30% of your time) Serve as the primary liaison between Dr. Javaid and the podcast production team Coordinate all podcast assets with the production team — episode files, artwork, guest information, and publish dates Ensure production team has everything they need on schedule — no delays, no dropped handoffs Coordinate guest scheduling — send calendar invites, confirmation email s, and pre-interview prep documents Manage guest communication professionally and promptly Maintain a running episode tracker — titles, guests, publish dates, and performance Add episode links, guest tags, and resource mentions to show notes once delivered by production team Proactively flag any production delays or asset gaps to Dr. Javaid Take social assets that are created by podcast team and repurpose them for Linked in, IG and Tiktok- they only publish to youtube Email Marketing (10% of your time) Manage the Kit (ConvertKit) email platform Load and schedule the weekly Tuesday emai/substackl written by Dr. Javaid Monitor subscriber growth and report weekly Ensure welcome sequence is functioning correctly for all new subscribers Tag and segment subscribers as the list grows Flag any deliverability issues or unsubscribe spikes immediately Design & Branded Assets (10% of your time) Design on-brand assets in Canva — media kits, one-pagers, speaker sheets, and pitch decks that match Dr. Javaid’s visual identity Create educational materials — patient-friendly explainers, downloadable guides, carousels, and infographics that translate clinical topics into clear, accessible visuals Make simple website updates — refresh copy, swap images, add press mentions, and post new resources (no advanced coding required) Maintain brand consistency across every asset — colors, fonts, logos, and tone per the brand playbook Keep a tidy, versioned library of templates and source files so assets can be reused and updated quickly Executive Assistant & Coordination (10% of your time) Manage Dr. Javaid’s calendar — schedule and confirm appointments, protect filming and focus time, resolve conflicts, and send timely reminders Manage Dr. Javaid’s inbox — triage incoming email , flag anything requiring her personal response, draft routine replies, and keep it organized Maintain organized Google Drive folders for all content assets Keep a running content asset library — all filmed videos, graphics, captions, and hashtag stacks organized by platform and date Proactively flag scheduling conflicts, platform issues, or anything that needs Dr. Javaid’s attention 04  |  TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW Required — must have experience with these: Google Workspace — Gmail and Google Calendar (inbox and calendar management) Canva — design of branded assets: media kits, educational materials, carousels, and text overlays Website CMS — comfortable making simple edits (e.g. Squarespace, WordPress, Webflow, or similar) Caption burning tool (CapCut, Descript, or similar) — for Shorts and TikToks Kit / ConvertKit — email marketing platform Google Drive — file management and organization Zoom or similar — podcast guest coordination Nice to have — not required but a strong advantage: Descript — podcast editing and transcription Riverside.fm or similar — podcast platform familiarity Basic video editing (CapCut, Veed, Elva Opus AI Premiere Rush, or similar) Adobe Express, Figma, or InDesign — for more polished design work Notion or Airtable — content calendar management Meta Ads Manager — basic familiarity 05  |  WHO YOU ARE You are the right person for this role if: Your written English is excellent — you can write captions that sound like a confident, credentialed American woman and nobody would know they were written by someone overseas You are obsessively organized — you do not miss deadlines, you do not forget tasks, and you proactively flag problems before they become Dr. Javaid’s problem You understand social media deeply — you know the difference between an Instagram Reel and a carousel, why TikTok needs different captions than Instagram, and why YouTube titles need to be searchable You are proactive not reactive — you do not wait to be told what to do next. You know the plan, you follow it, and you flag anything that is off You take brand seriously — you understand that Dr. Javaid’s brand is built on clinical authority and bold personal narrative, and you protect that voice in every caption you write You have a strong design eye — you can build clean, on-brand assets in Canva and turn complex clinical topics into clear, professional visuals without hand-holding You are comfortable with health and medical content — you are not squeamish about topics like menopause, sexual health, hormones, and women’s bodies You have worked with a personal brand or public figure before — you understand the sensitivity and discretion that comes with managing someone’s public presence This role is NOT right for you if: You need constant supervision or daily check-ins to stay on task Your written English requires heavy editing before it is publishable You treat social media as just a scheduling job — this role requires genuine understanding of what makes content perform You are not available during overlap hours with US Eastern or Central time 06  |  AVAILABILITY & COMMUNICATION 20 hours per week — part-time with potential to grow Must be available for a 30-minute weekly check-in call with Dr. Javaid or her team — Tuesday mornings US Central time preferred Must respond to messages within 4 hours during your working day Must be available same-day for urgent requests — a viral post or breaking news ---------- nt may require fast action Weekly deliverable: content queue submitted for approval every Wednesday morning without exception ?  Time zone: Philippines, Latin America, or Eastern Europe preferred for overlap with US Central time. Please state your time zone clearly in your application. 07  |  COMPENSATION Starting rate: Competitive and commensurate with experience. Please state your expected monthly rate in your application. Hours: 20 hours per week with potential to grow as the brand scales. Trial period: All candidates complete a paid trial project before a full-time offer is made. Trial compensation is $75 USD. Full details of the trial project are in Section 08. Growth: This role has significant growth potential. Dr. Javaid is actively building toward a book launch, a TikTok Shop, and expanded keynote business. The right person grows with the brand. 08  |  THE TRIAL PROJECT All shortlisted candidates complete this paid trial before a hiring decision is made. This is how we find the right person — not by resume, but by actual work. Compensation: $75 USD upon completion Timeline: 48 hours from assignment to submission TRIAL TASK 1 — Content Packaging & Handoff Brief Using the sample assets and weekly schedule provided, outline exactly how you would prepare one full week of content for Dr. Javaid across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube and hand it to the PR team ready to publish. For each piece include: platform, content type, what you would adapt per platform (captions, overlays, format), and how you would package and deliver it so nothing is missed. Then, in a few sentences, describe how you would keep her calendar and inbox in order during a heavy filming week. TRIAL TASK 2 — Caption Writing Write Instagram and TikTok captions for the following post: Dr. Javaid is posting a 45-second Reel where she looks directly to camera and says: “Did you know PCOS was just renamed? Your doctor probably hasn’t told you yet. The new name is PMOS — Polyendocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome. This isn’t just a name change. It’s a reclassification that could change how millions of women are diagnosed and treated. I have this condition. I was dismissed by doctors. Even as a physician. Here’s what you need to know.” End of video. Write: (a) an Instagram caption with appropriate hashtags, and (b) a TikTok caption with appropriate hashtags. title: Daily Thumbnail Designer (Photoshop) for How-To YouTube Content
job_title: Daily Thumbnail Designer (Photoshop) for How-To YouTube Content
description: Hi! I'm looking for a thumbnail designer to work with me every day, long term. I make how-to and tutorial videos and I'm moving toward high-volume output, so I need someone who can produce thumbnails quickly, consistently, and on-brand every single day. THE STYLE All my thumbnails follow one consistent look: - A cut-out presenter on one side. - An app screenshot or logo on the other side, with a bold red arrow pointing to the key spot. - Large uppercase text at the bottom in bright green and white. - Bright, clean, high-contrast, and the same feel across every video. I already have a finished Photoshop template plus all brand assets and reference thumbnails. Once we connect I'll share these with you, so you'll mainly be swapping the screenshot, arrow, text and presenter image for each new video and keeping everything sharp and consistent. THE WORK - Multiple thumbnails per day, every day, delivered reliably. - Each one on-brand, clean and ready to publish. - This is built for volume, so speed and consistency matter as much as quality. REQUIREMENTS - Photoshop only. No Canva or other tools. This is important to me. - A real understanding of what makes a thumbnail work: clear focal point, readable text, strong contrast. - Reliable daily delivery. - Good communication and open to feedback. A PLUS - Some experience with AI tools like ChatGPT for generating or cleaning up design elements. It is not the core of the job, but I use AI in my own workflow, so it helps if you are comfortable leaning on it to make things look clean. PAY $0.20 per thumbnail to start. I pay bonuses for designers who show real dedication and deliver consistently, and the rate goes up once you prove yourself reliable. There's room for steady, ongoing work for the right person. TO APPLY - Start your message with the word "ORANGE" so I know you read this fully. - Share a few thumbnails you've made in Photoshop. - Tell me how many you can realistically deliver per day.

description: YouTube Vlog Editor / Retention Editor for Weekly Lifestyle & Brand Vlogs We are looking for an experienced YouTube video editor to edit weekly iPhone-style lifestyle vlogs for a growing personal/brand YouTube channel. This is not a basic cutting job. We need someone who understands YouTube pacing, retention, thumbnails, titles, hooks, and how to turn raw lifestyle footage into a video people actually want to keep watching. The videos will be filmed mostly on iPhone. The footage will include day-to-day lifestyle, behind-the-scenes moments, building a clothing brand, working out, eating, business, travel, creative direction, and general vlog-style content. The final videos will usually be around 15–20 minutes long. Video Style - The style should feel like a fast-paced lifestyle vlog with consistent clip changes. Most clips should be around 5–20 seconds max unless there is an important direct-to-camera moment or a serious story section that needs more time. The goal is clip after clip after clip, while still making the video feel natural, entertaining, and easy to follow. Reference style: Levi Bent-Lee, Jet Bent-Lee, Marcus Milione and similar lifestyle vlog creators. We do not want to copy anyone directly, but we want someone who understands that type of pacing, storytelling, and YouTube culture. Responsibilities You will be responsible for: 1. Editing 1 long-form YouTube vlog per week 2. Turning raw iPhone footage into a 15–20 minute engaging vlog 3. Watching through all footage and selecting the best moments 4. Creating a strong hook/opening for each video 5. Building the story of the vlog, not just cutting clips together 6. Keeping the pacing fast and engaging 7. Removing dead space, boring moments, and unnecessary pauses 8. Using non-copyrighted music 9. Adding sound effects or memes only when they fit naturally 10. Making the video entertaining without making it feel childish, corny, or overly meme-heavy 11. Creating multiple engaging thumbnail options 12. Providing title options based on proven YouTube title styles that work for similar videos 13. Delivering the first final cut by Monday each week 14. Completing revisions before the video is posted on Wednesday or Thursday 15. Thumbnail & Title Expectations 16. Thumbnails and titles are extremely important for this role. 17. title: Junior Motion Designer (Adobe After Effects)
description: We are looking for a full-time Junior/Intermediate After Effects Designer who wants to become an expert in Adobe After Effects and motion graphics. We (Motion Current LLC) have been creating professional motion graphics for more than 20 years. Our work usually displayed on large LED screens and jumbotrons for casinos, banks, car dealerships, sports stadiums, and other businesses. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems, and improving their skills every day. You do not need to be an expert today. We are looking for someone who is motivated, dependable, and excited to learn. The most important requirement is a strong desire to become an After Effects expert. What We Are Looking For: • Reliable and dependable • Good communication skills • Able to follow instructions • Comfortable asking questions when needed • Willing to learn (mostly) independently • Interested in a long-term career in motion graphics • Enjoys using AI tools to learn faster, solve problems, and generate graphics. We expect the person we hire to spend a significant amount of time learning Adobe After Effects and Adobe Photoshop. Daily Responsibilities: • Check in through chat at the beginning of each workday is required. I don't want to use Timeproof unless necessary. • Check out through chat at the end of each workday. • Submit a daily report showing what you learned, created, or worked on. • Include links to tutorials, resources, or projects completed during the day. We'll provide you with a Box.com account. • Create motion graphic advertisements and animation projects. • Continue learning new After Effects techniques and workflows. First Few Weeks: During the first few weeks, your main goal will be learning and practicing Adobe After Effects. You will follow online tutorials (YouTube, chatgpt, other online resources), complete exercises (AI can help you learn faster), and build projects while learning. You should be familiar and comfortable with Keyframes, Layers, Animation basics, Rendering and exporting, and Project organization. Multiple 10-second projects are expected each week during this stage. Next Stage: As your skills improve, you will begin creating original motion graphics without relying on step-by-step tutorials. You will be able to build / modify assets in Adobe Photoshop or using AI that are used in your motion graphic animations. You should be comfortable with Easy Easing, Masks, Blend Modes, Motion design principles, and Professional workflows. Multiple 10-second projects will continue to be expected each week. Long-Term Growth: Over time, the goal is to become an advanced After Effects designer. You will be able to recreate almost any type of commercial motion graphic you see. You know how to build advanced projects from scratch, create reusable After Effects templates, work with expressions, build complex pre-compositions, design projects for multiple screen sizes and aspect ratios, create graphics using AI-generated and custom-built assets. As your skills continue to grow, you will also learn Blender, Video Copilot Element 3D, and other 3D animation and motion design workflows. Requirements: • Your own computer. It needs to be able to run Adobe After Effects 2026. • Internet connection. We will ask you about your speed and how frequently you have outages. • Interest in learning and using AI tools. After you are hired, we'll provide an Adobe license and access to share files on Box.com. Work Schedule: The first few days of training and onboarding will be completed during our time zone (Mountain Time Zone) of the United States. We're based in Utah. Once training and onboarding is completed, expectations are understood, and communication systems are established, you can transition to working Philippine hours. Please include a portfolio, website, demo reel, or examples of your motion graphics work. Applications without examples of any type of graphics work will not be considered. If you advance to the interview process, you will be required to complete a 5 to 10 minute test in After Effects during the interview process with us so we can evaluate your current level of skill in After Effects. This will be done during the video call interview. We will share monitors and allow you to have keyboard and mouse control temporarily to do this test. This test will be on a PC (Windows 11) with After Effects 2026. We will show you a completed motion graphic 10-second animation and give you the assets (images/videos) required to recreate this animation. You will be given 5 to 10 minutes to recreate the completed animation. Application Instructions: To confirm that you read this entire job posting, begin your application with the words: "AE is After Effects". Long-Term Opportunity: We are looking for someone to grow with our company for years, not weeks or months. The right person can eventually become our Lead Template Designer and help build our growing motion graphics template library. Compensation: Starting salary: $1,200 - $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience, skill level, and portfolio. This amount does not include any additional money to cover the 2% forex fee. Payment will be processed through Easypay / Payoneer. Annual performance reviews and salary increases are available as skills improve and responsibilities grow.

title: AI Video Creator
description: We're not hiring someone to "make videos." We're hiring someone to move humans — to take the raw clay of footage, AI tools, and a story worth telling, and shape it into something that makes a stranger stop scrolling, lean in, and feel something real. Then act on it. Who You Are You're a Storyteller First, Technologist Second. Anyone can prompt an AI tool. Almost nobody can tell a story that makes a CFO tear up at a B2B brand video. That's the gap we're hiring for. You're Emotionally Intelligent — and It Shows in the Work. You can read a room, read a brief, and read a person's face on camera and know when they're holding back. You understand that great marketing isn't about being clever — it's about being true. You make people feel seen. That's the unfair advantage you bring. - You're Motivated by Impact, Not Output. You don't measure your week in videos shipped. You measure it in whether the work moved someone — a customer, a candidate, a community. You'd rather make 10 videos that matter than 100 that don't. - You Have Range. You can make us laugh on Tuesday and make us cry on Thursday. You can write a 15-second hook and a 6-minute brand film. You can shoot on an iPhone in a coffee shop and direct a polished studio piece. You Move Fast Without Breaking Trust. You ship. You iterate. You don't disappear into perfectionism for three weeks. But you also don't publish anything you wouldn't be proud to sign your name to. You're a Pro With AI — Not a Tourist. You've already built workflows nobody taught you. You know which tools are hype and which are durable. You know when to use AI and, more importantly, when not to. Non-Negotiables - Portfolio that makes us jealous. Show us the work. We'd rather see three pieces you're proud of than a sizzle reel of everything you've ever touched. - 3+ years producing video for marketing or brand, ideally in a fast-moving environment where you weren't handed a 50-page brand book. - Demonstrated AI fluency. You can walk us through a video you made where AI was central to the workflow — and explain the choices, including the human ones. - Strong writing. If you can't write, you can't make great video. Period. - You actually like people. This job involves real humans on camera. They'll feel how you feel about them. The chance to build something. A team that takes the work seriously and themselves lightly. Direct line to leadership — your ideas get heard, your wins get noticed, your work goes out the door. Compensation that matches the talent we're looking for. And the rare gift of doing work you can point to in five years and say: that one mattered.

description: About the Project You'll examine designs to understand color schemes, font choices, and other design elements. You will then review a slide within that design that seems out of place. Strong visual discrimination and consistent aesthetic judgment - Reliability and consistency in your evaluation standards - Self-motivated with ability to work independently on repetitive tasks - Strong communication skills for flagging edge cases or unclear examples - Comfortable with feedback and re-calibration Preferred Background (not required, but preferred) - Portfolio demonstrating diverse design work and critical eye - Experience as a design reviewer, art director, or in quality assurance roles - Prior data annotation, content moderation, or quality evaluation experience - Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG, inclusive design principles) - Knowledge of design across multiple contexts (branding, editorial, digital, UX/UI) Work Style - High tolerance for repetitive evaluation tasks—finds rhythm and satisfaction in systematic work - Ability to maintain consistent standards across thousands of ratings - Strong pattern recognition—quickly identifying quality patterns across examples - Disciplined, methodical approach with minimal variation in judgment - Problem-solving mindset for handling ambiguous or borderline cases - Interest in AI/ML applications in design and creative fields - Previous remote work experience with self-directed tasks
