title: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film
job_title: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film
description: AI Product Video Creator – Ballistic-Protected Container Film We are looking for an experienced AI video creator / video editor to produce a professional product film for a specialized industrial / defense-related product: a sea container protected with a ballistic coating. This is a one-time paid project, but it may lead to more product videos, industrial presentations, AI films and marketing materials in the future. ## Project Overview The product is a sea container with a protective ballistic coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk and improve safety in high-risk environments. The container can be used in: * conflict-risk zones, * military or security environments, * field bases, * logistics zones, * temporary operational areas, * checkpoints, * emergency infrastructure, * equipment storage areas, * industrial and uniformed services applications. The film will be used mainly for business communication with Ukrainian companies, institutions, contractors and potential distributors. It may be sent together with a PDF product presentation or placed on a simple landing page with product information. The goal is to present the product as a practical, serious and professional protective solution for demanding environments. ## Important Style Direction We do **not** want a Hollywood action trailer. We do **not** want exaggerated war scenes, explosions, violence, gore or political propaganda. We need a realistic, industrial, serious B2B product film. The style should feel: * realistic, * industrial, * cinematic but controlled, * professional, * technical, * practical, * suitable for B2B / institutional buyers, * suitable for the Ukrainian market, * serious and trustworthy. Think more: industrial defense product presentation / field logistics solution / protective infrastructure film. Think less: action movie / war propaganda / dramatic combat trailer. ## Materials We Will Provide We will provide: * product photos, * product description, * technical information, * website link, * visual references, * key selling points, * company / contact details for final screen. The film should be generated and edited using AI tools and video editing tools based on these materials. You may use AI video, AI image generation, editing, motion graphics, overlays, cinematic transitions, sound design, product visualization and realistic environment creation. ## What the Film Should Show The film should present: * the container as a real industrial / protective product, * the ballistic coating as a protective surface layer, * possible use in high-risk environments, * use in field / military / logistics / temporary infrastructure settings, * mobility and practical deployment, * potential functions such as: * field office, * equipment storage, * temporary shelter, * logistics point, * technical room, * checkpoint, * operational support unit, * the concept of reducing fragmentation risk, * professional use by companies, services, contractors or uniformed units. ## Suggested Film Structure The final creative structure can be proposed by you, but one possible scenario is: ### 1. Opening Environment A realistic field logistics environment: temporary base, industrial yard, training ground or operational zone. Dust, vehicles in the distance, serious atmosphere, calm cinematic movement. Text idea: “Protective modular infrastructure for high-risk environments.” ### 2. Product Reveal The sea container appears as a strong, practical structure. Slow camera movement around the container. Close-ups of the coated surface. Text idea: “Sea container with ballistic protective coating.” ### 3. Risk Context Subtle reference to difficult environments: damaged infrastructure, distant smoke, field logistics, temporary deployment, security area. No graphic violence, no direct combat scenes. Text idea: “Designed for environments where fragmentation risk and operational safety matter.” ### 4. Protection Layer Visualization A clean visual showing the coating layer on the container surface. This can be done through AI, motion graphics or simple technical overlay. Text idea: “Protective coating designed to reduce fragmentation risk.” ### 5. Use Cases Fast but clear sequence showing possible applications: * field office, * storage unit, * temporary shelter, * logistics point, * equipment room, * checkpoint, * emergency infrastructure. Text idea: “Mobile. Practical. Adaptable.” ### 6. Deployment Container transported, placed on site, used as part of a temporary base or operational zone. ### 7. Closing Frame Strong final frame with the container in a serious field / industrial environment. Text idea: “Protective container solutions for demanding conditions.” Final screen: company name / website / contact details. ## Expected Deliverables Please quote for one or more of the following packages: ### Basic Package * Main film: 45–75 seconds * 1 thumbnail / cover * 1–2 revision rounds ### Extended Package * Main film: 45–75 seconds * 30-second version * 15-second teaser * 1 thumbnail / cover * 3–5 still visuals for PDF or landing page * 1–2 revision rounds ### Optional Add-ons * Ukrainian language text version * English language text version * Polish language text version * social media format versions * landing page hero video loop * extra thumbnails / stills ## Tools / Skills Needed Please tell us which tools you use, for example: * Runway, * Kling, * Luma, * Veo / Flow, * Midjourney, * ChatGPT, * CapCut, * Adobe Premiere Pro, * DaVinci Resolve, * After Effects, * Photoshop, * Canva, * other AI image / video tools. We are especially interested in creators who can combine AI-generated scenes with realistic product presentation, industrial environments and clean editing. ## Application Requirements Please apply with the subject: **BALLISTIC CONTAINER AI FILM** In your application, please include: 1. Your portfolio or links to similar AI video / product video / industrial video work. 2. Which AI video tools you use. 3. Which editing tools you use. 4. Your proposed approach for this project. 5. Estimated price for the Basic Package. 6. Estimated price for the Extended Package. 7. Estimated delivery time. 8. Number of revision rounds included. 9. Whether you can create realistic industrial / defense-style visuals without making the film look like an action movie. 10. Whether you can prepare English and/or Ukrainian text versions. Applications without video examples or portfolio links will not be considered. ## Important Notes This film is for a serious B2B product presentation. It must look professional, realistic and practical. It should not include graphic violence, political messaging, unrealistic combat scenes or exaggerated explosions. We are looking for someone who understands how to create a premium industrial product video using AI while keeping the tone serious, credible and business-oriented.

description: I'll keep this real so neither of us wastes time???? I make AI UGC videos, the creator-style clips that sell products, using Veo inside Flow. I'm looking for one person to help me crank them out. Good news first: you're not starting from a blank page. I give you the script and the first hook prompt, and your job is to turn that into a finished video. In practice that means building out the rest of the prompts (Claude helps a ton here), generating the footage in Veo, then re-rolling clips until they look right. That last part is most of the job, if I'm honest. After that you edit it all together, captions and sound and pacing, into something people don't scroll past. Some days that's ten versions of one idea. Some days it's a single video you fuss over till it's right. Before you apply, you need two things: 1.A Flow subscription and a Claude subscription, both active. The whole job runs on these, so I need you ready on day one, not getting set up next week. 2.A computer and solid wifi. You're rendering and uploading video all day, and bad internet kills this job. Then here's what I care about in a person: 1.Your English is good. Easy to talk to, easy to understand. We'll be on Telegram every day, so this one matters a lot. 2.You reply. If I text you and you're slammed, just say "busy, on it tonight." I don't need a paragraph, I just hate wondering whether you saw it. 3.You've got an eye. You can feel the gap between a video that's fine and one that lands, and the fine one bugs you a little. You notice the small stuff. The caption that's a frame late, the weird extra finger in one clip, the audio that drifts slightly off. You catch it before I do, because with AI video that tiny detail is the whole difference between something that looks cheap and something that looks real. 4.You're someone I'd want to talk to daily. I'll take a person I like over a slightly faster robot every time. 5.You care about this stuff and want to get good at it. A degree's a nice bonus, not a dealbreaker. One small thing: I read every application that comes in. So I know you got this far, open your message with the word pineapple. No word, I move on. How it works from here: You apply with the word. We get on a quick call so I can hear how you think. If we click, I send you the trial below. It's paid, and it's the whole game, whoever nails it is the person I hire. If the trial's strong, we do a proper onboarding call and you're in. The trial: Recreate this video: ---------- Here's the base character reference you'll work from: ---------- Same energy, same style. Here's the script word for word, five scenes: 1.When you are done eating chicken wings, do not throw out the bones, folks. 2.Wash them, bake at 450 degrees for 45 minutes, and grind to a fine powder. Now here is what most folks never figured out. 3.That powder is full of calcium and collagen. It strengthens the teeth, eases stiff joints, and settles the gut. 4.Stir a spoonful into your coffee or soup each morning. 5.Comment book and follow me to receive my full Amish healing collection. The voice is a middle-aged Amish woman. To land it, use this as your audio prompt: "She is a middle-aged Amish woman:" Anyone can read a script over some footage. What I'm grading is the detail. Get every one of these right and the job is yours: 1.Constant camera movement in every single scene. Nothing static. 2.A different background in each scene. Don't reuse one. 3.Different tools and props throughout. 4.A hook that makes the video even more engaging than the original. 5.The whole thing runs under 30 seconds. 6.No anomalies. It has to look genuinely real, no AI weirdness anywhere. 7.No typos in the captions. 8.No vocal glitches or weird audio. Pay: Base plus bonuses. Your videos perform, you earn more. Simple. hint: If you reach 1m views on a video you get $100, but this is not the only bonus, theres more. If you are hungry for success and you want to make 1k-2k a month and you wanna prove the people who doubted you, this is the right place. At last, you need to have a students mind, if you are willing to learn, we can't work together.

title: Video and Motion Graphics Editor
description: Yes, that's a materially different role. What you've described is not a learning designer, instructional designer, curriculum designer, or educational producer. It's much closer to: **Video Editor & Learning Assets Designer** or **Educational Media Editor** The distinction is important because they are *not* d ---------- what gets taught, how the curriculum is structured, or how the learning experience is designed. Those decisions have already been made. Their job is to take finished materials and turn them into polished learner-facing assets. I'd redefine the role around that reality. --- The Role You will be responsible for producing the final learner-facing media and resources including videos and PDFs. Working from AI-generated presenter videos, production briefs and established templates, you will assemble finished class videos, create supporting visual elements, and produce downloadable learning resources. Your role is to ensure that all learner-facing content is professionally produced, visually coherent, engaging and consistent with the studio's quality standards. You will become the final stage of the production process before content is published. --- Core Responsibilities Video Editing & Assembly Take AI-generated presenter footage created in platforms such as Synthesia and HeyGen and assemble it into completed class videos. This includes: * Editing and sequencing video segments * Managing pacing and flow * Adding titles and lower thirds * Adding captions and on-screen text * Integrating motion graphics * Incorporating diagrams and visual aids * Sourcing and integrating b-roll footage * Adding transitions and visual polish * Ensuring consistency across all lessons Work primarily with Adobe: Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop --- Motion Graphics & Visual Elements Create simple but professional motion graphics that enhance understanding and engagement. Examples include: * Animated diagrams * Timelines * Framework visualisations * Process maps * On-screen callouts * Text animations * Lesson openers and closers The goal is clarity and professionalism rather than flashy animation. --- Worksheet & Resource Production Create learner resources using established templates and brand guidelines. This may include: * Worksheets * Reflection exercises * Planning templates * Checklists * Implementation guides * Course handouts * Downloadable resources Ensure resources are visually appealing, easy to use and consistent with studio standards. --- Visual Asset Creation Create supporting graphics and visual assets for courses where required. Examples include: * Infographics * Process diagrams * Icons * Course thumbnails * Presentation graphics * Resource illustrations Use a combination of design tools and AI-assisted creative tools where appropriate. --- Production Quality Control Review all assets before publication. Ensure consistency across: * Visual style * Branding * Typography * Layout * Naming conventions * Production quality Maintain a professional and polished learner experience across the entire platform. --- ### Essential Skills * Strong video editing skills * Excellent attention to detail * Experience with Premiere Pro (or equivalent) * Basic motion graphics capability * Strong visual design judgement * Ability to follow brand and template guidelines * Strong organisational skills * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously --- ### Desirable Skills * After Effects * Canva * Photoshop * Illustrator * Figma * Experience creating educational content * Familiarity with AI media tools * Experience working with online course platforms --- ### What Success Looks Like Every lesson feels professionally produced. Video content is clear, engaging and visually polished. Motion graphics help understanding rather than distract from it. Worksheets and resources are attractive, practical and consistent. Learners experience a seamless visual identity across the entire studio. The production quality of the content significantly increases the perceived value of the membership. About Us The Coaches Business Studio and Coloqia are part of a growing family of education businesses created by the team behind Animas. Founded in 2008, Animas is one of the world's leading coach training schools, having trained thousands of coaches across more than 90 countries. Over the past decade, the organisation has built a reputation for high-quality professional education, thoughtful learning design and innovative approaches to coach development. Behind the scenes, we are supported by an experienced Filipino operations and production team that has been working together since 2017. This team has played a central role in the growth and success of Animas and now forms the operational foundation for our newer ventures. The Coaches Business Studio and Coloqia represent the next stage of that evolution. Both are specialist education platforms built around AI-avatar-led learning, combining expert-designed curricula, modern production methods and emerging AI technologies to create flexible, scalable learning experiences. Although these ventures use new technologies and new delivery models, they are built by the same team, guided by the same commitment to educational quality, learner experience and long-term thinking that has shaped Animas over many years.

What You’ll Create This is a launch project first, with ongoing design work to follow as we grow. To start, you’ll design: • A complete logo suite and brand identity. • Our color palette, typography, and a simple brand guidelines document. • Menu cards and price boards. • Packaging — cups, labels, branded stickers, and to-go items. • In-store signage and display graphics. • Loyalty cards and promotional pieces. • A starter kit of social media templates and launch content for Instagram and TikTok. Once the brand is established, we’d love to keep working with you on an ongoing basis for social content, new campaigns, and seasonal designs as the business expands from our pilot toward a flagship Miami café. Who We’re Looking For • A strong portfolio in branding and graphic design — ideally with food, beverage, wellness, or lifestyle work. • A real sense of modern, minimalist aesthetics and clean typography. • Skilled in industry-standard tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, or Canva Pro). • Able to take a brand vision and run with it — thoughtful, self-directed, and detail-oriented. • Good written English and clear, responsive communication for remote collaboration. • Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines. Why You’ll Love This Project • Build a real brand from scratch — a standout, complete identity for your portfolio. • Creative freedom and a direct line to the founders, with no layers of bureaucracy. • Fully remote, flexible hours — work from wherever you are. • A genuine chance for an ongoing, long-term working relationship as we grow. • A fun, positive, healthy brand you’ll actually enjoy designing for. How to Apply Please send your portfolio (or a link to it) along with a short note about why this project excites you. If you have any food, beverage, or wellness branding in your portfolio, point us to it. We can’t wait to see your work and find the designer who’ll help shape the face of Skyr N Bowls. Eating healthy is an act of self-love — come help us make it beautiful.

description: Type: Full-time, long-term Pay: $1,000–$1,500/month retainer + leaderboard performance bonuses Hours: ~40/week, Monday–Friday (weekends optional but encouraged) Location: Fully remote ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT THIS IS ------------------------------------------------------------ I'm hiring a direct response video editor to join our creative team. You'd come in as an editor — but I do need someone who already has solid experience and a strong skillset, not a beginner. Full-time and long-term for the right person, not a one-off gig. ------------------------------------------------------------ ABOUT US ------------------------------------------------------------ You'll be working with a fast-growing health and wellness brand scaling hard in the US market. We run a huge creative team that ships a high volume of paid ad creatives every week, and we spend serious money on ads — so the work you make actually goes out and gets tested at scale. You'll see real numbers on your edits, not just upload and forget. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHO I'M LOOKING FOR ------------------------------------------------------------ A direct response editor who makes ads built to perform, not just look nice. If you've only ever done pretty edits with no understanding of what makes an ad convert, this probably isn't for you. You should be able to cut these ad styles confidently: - AI UGC ads - Voiceover + b-roll style ads - Greenscreen / AI avatar style - Claymation / Pixar / 3D animation style - Podcast-style ads - And honestly, whatever style is winning right now You'll be making a high volume of AI-generated creative — AI UGC, claymation, Pixar-style, podcast ads, avatars, and more — so you need to be genuinely comfortable producing and blending AI generative assets into ads that convert. ------------------------------------------------------------ THE ACTUAL EDITING SKILLS YOU NEED ------------------------------------------------------------ This is the part people usually leave vague, so let me be specific. Day to day, you'll need to be genuinely good at: HOOKS & RETENTION EDITING You understand the first 3 seconds make or break an ad. You know how to open strong, hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts, and pacing, and keep someone watching to the CTA. PACING & RHYTHM You cut to the energy of the voiceover/script — tight where it needs to be, never letting a clip drag. Your edits feel fast and snappy without being messy. STORYTELLING TO A SCRIPT You can take a VO or ad script and build the visual story around it: matching b-roll, on-screen text, and beats to what's being said so the message actually lands. B-ROLL SOURCING & SEQUENCING You know how to find (or generate) the right supporting footage and place it so it reinforces the message, not just fills space. CAPTIONS & ON-SCREEN TEXT Clean, readable, well-timed subtitles and kinetic text — styled to match the brand, synced properly, and used to drive retention (not just slapped on). SOUND DESIGN Music selection that fits the mood, proper audio leveling, SFX and "whooshes" on transitions, ducking music under VO. Bad audio kills good visuals. BASIC MOTION GRAPHICS & TEXT ANIMATION Simple, clean animated text, callouts, highlights, and transitions that look professional. COLOR & CLEANUP Basic correction so clips match and look consistent, plus a clean, polished finish (no jarring cuts, no random aspect-ratio jumps). AI GENERATION You can actually prompt and produce usable assets — AI UGC clips, claymation, Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images — and blend them into a real ad so it doesn't look obviously AI. ORGANIZATION Named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines. You make it easy for the team to work with you. ------------------------------------------------------------ TOOLS YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW ------------------------------------------------------------ CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, Veo 3, Nano Banana, Higgsfield — and whatever else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every single week and I need someone who actually keeps up, not someone I have to drag along. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU'LL OWN (KPIs) ------------------------------------------------------------ DAILY OUTPUT: 1–3+ high-quality ad creatives per day, following our scripts and styles. 70% FIRST-PASS APPROVAL RATE: At least 7 out of 10 of your submissions should require no revisions — meaning they match the brief and are ready to test. AVAILABILITY: Online and responsive Monday–Friday. Weekends are optional but encouraged for the people who want to climb the leaderboard faster. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT MATTERS MOST (BEYOND THE SKILLS) ------------------------------------------------------------ - DTC experience is a must. You've already worked with one or more DTC / ecom brands — this is non-negotiable. Show me the work. - You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop. - Mindset — this is the big one. Coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, and the type who tries to overdeliver instead of doing the bare minimum. You don't have to be perfect on day one. But you should be good enough to hit the ground running and hungry enough to keep leveling up. We've got a head editor who'll guide you on frameworks, hook structures, and what actually makes an ad win — so this is a genuine chance to learn ecom and direct response from the inside while getting paid well to do it. ------------------------------------------------------------ COMPENSATION ------------------------------------------------------------ Base retainer: $1,000–$1,500/month, depending on your skill level and experience. Retainers go up over time as your skills grow and you take on more responsibility. Leaderboard bonuses — on top of your retainer. Here's how it works: the editor with the highest number of winning ads gets first place, and so on. The whole team is ranked on a leaderboard each month, and the top 5 editors get paid bonuses on top of their base. The better your creatives perform, the higher you climb, the more you earn. ???? 1st place: $[500] ???? 2nd place: $[400] ???? 3rd place: $[300] 4?? 4th place: $[200] 5?? 5th place: $[100] We spend at a scale where this adds up to real money for editors who consistently ship winners. The leaderboard isn't just for show — it's there so the people putting in the work actually get rewarded for it. ------------------------------------------------------------ THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF ------------------------------------------------------------ - You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response. If you can't explain why a hook works or what makes an ad convert, this isn't the role. - You need hand-holding. You'll get guidance and frameworks from our head editor, but you're expected to manage your own workload, hit deadlines, and solve problems without constant check-ins. - You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things. Our stack changes weekly. If a new AI tool drops and the team adopts it overnight, you need to pivot without frustration. - You see this as "just a job." The people who win here are genuinely into short-form, AI creative, and direct response — and want to grow with a fast-scaling brand, not clock in and out. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------------------------------------ In your proposal, include: - The Names of the previous Ecom Brands/Companies you have edited for - A short description of your current skillset. - A few examples of past ad creative work (UGC, voiceover, animation — whatever you've got) to back it up, including the DTC brand(s) you've worked with. Then answer these questions: 1. Pick one ad creative you've made that performed well. Break down WHY it worked from a direct-response angle — the hook, pacing, offer, CTA, or any specific editing choice that drove the result. 2. Tell me about a creative that underperformed. How did you use the performance data to figure out why, what did you change in the next version, and what happened? 3. Walk me through how you produce AI UGC or generative ads (claymation, Pixar, podcast, avatar, etc.) so they don't look obviously AI. What's your process and which tools do you reach for? 4. This role is high-volume — 1 to 3+ creatives a day. Describe your experience working at that kind of pace and how you keep quality high while moving fast. Include the code word 'ScaleMode' somewhere in your application. I only review applications that include it — it tells me you actually read the post and pay attention to detail. Then submit the trial task after you send your proposal. That's it. Looking forward to seeing what you can do.

Then send a 30 second Loom with your camera on, showing your face, telling me in clear English why I should hire you over everyone else, based on your specific skills. This role is for a highly skilled professional who understands storytelling, pacing, and premium color—and can consistently deliver polished, luxury-level video content. About the Role As our Senior Video Editor, you will be responsible for editing a steady volume of luxury real estate videos, including cinematic property tours, agent-led videos, and brand storytelling content. Every project should reflect a refined, high-end aesthetic—clean edits, intentional pacing, natural yet elevated color grading, and seamless motion. This is not a template-driven role. We value precision, consistency, and creative craftsmanship. Required Expertise - 8+ years of professional video editing experience (senior level) - Strong background in: - Luxury real estate video editing - Cinematic property tours - Agent/on-camera videos - Story-driven brand content Advanced expertise in: - High-end color grading (natural, clean, luxury tone) - DaVinci Resolve (required) - Speed ramping and motion timing - Music-driven editing and pacing - Clean, professional captioning for social and branding Deep understanding of: - Visual storytelling and narrative flow - Shot selection and sequencing - Matching footage across multiple cameras and lighting conditions - Maintaining consistency across projects and clients Technical Requirements / Advanced proficiency in: - DaVinci Resolve (primary editing platform) - Strong working knowledge of: - Color management and node-based grading workflows - Export settings for social media, MLS, and high-end marketing use Strictly no reliance on: AI-generated edits Auto-cutting or template-based platforms What We’re Looking For A dedicated full-time editor—not a freelancer splitting attention. Someone who understands luxury pacing—when to slow down, when to build energy Strong attention to detail (no sloppy cuts, mismatched color, or over-editing) Ability to create emotion-driven edits, not just compile clips Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times Alignment with a premium, luxury brand aesthetic Nice to Have Experience editing $1M+ luxury listings Familiarity with real estate marketing trends and agent branding Experience working with drone footage and gimbal-based walkthroughs What Success Looks Like Videos feel intentional, cinematic, and elevated Agents look natural, confident, and well-paced on camera Every project reinforces a luxury brand standard Consistent quality across high volume without sacrificing detail

title: AI Video Editor
description: To apply Please only apply through this link: ---------- Summary We're a performance creative AGENCY looking for a part-time AI Video Editor who can take a script and turn it into a scroll-stopping, high-pace short-form video ad — start to finish, using an AI-first workflow. title: VIDEO EDITOR — UGC EDITING (RAW FOOTAGE)
description: VIDEO EDITOR — UGC EDITING (RAW FOOTAGE) Who we are We're a growing Dutch online fragrance (family) brand scaling ads on Meta. We're hiring a UGC video editor for stable, long-term weekly collaboration. What you'll do You'll edit one core format: UGC videos: We provide raw creator footage + a written brief. You edit it into authentic, engaging, scroll-stopping short-form ads (15 sec – 2 min.). No sourcing, no voice-over creation — just sharp, intentional editing of the footage we deliver to you. Each video takes approximately maximum 45–60 minutes. No complex effects needed. Clean, fast cuts that feel native to social media. What we're looking for Core requirements: 2–3 portfolio links (UGC short-form social ads strongly preferred) Reliable weekly deadline delivery Skilled with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or equivalent Able to follow written English briefs precisely Experience with captions, pacing, and hook-first editing structure Experience inserting image overlays (review screenshots, product cards) Strong advantages: Proven experience editing UGC creator footage specifically Eye for authentic, lo-fi feel — not over-produced or cinematic Comfortable using AI tools to improve workflow (we actively encourage AI use when quality is maintained) How to apply Include in your message: Start with the word "UGC" (attention check — shows you read this carefully) - Answer in 2–3 sentences: What's one editing technique you always use to make a UGC video stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds? - 2–3 portfolio links (UGC editing preferred) - Brief intro: who are you, how long have you been editing? - Available hours per week: - 5 brands or stores you've edited for - List your editing software and tools - Specify which AI tools you use, if any (e.g. HeyGen, CapCut AI, Adobe AI, etc.) Applications missing these details will not be reviewed. Pay & trial $10 per finished video After trial: fixed weekly position with better rates over time

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description: Short-Form Video Editor (Contract-to-Hire) — Localize Company: Localize, the farmers market & local farm finder app Role: Short-Form Video Editor Type: Contract-to-hire (trial task, then part-time contract, ramping to full-time) Location: Remote Niche: Health & wellness / local food About Localize Localize is a mobile app that helps people find local farms, farmers markets, and fresh food near them. We're currently doing 75 million views a month and are one of the fastest-growing mobile apps of 2026. We produce a steady stream of short-form video, including green screen explainers, food and farm content, and more across social, and we're looking for an editor to own the editing side of that pipeline so our creators can focus on filming. What you'll do You'll take finished scripts and raw footage and turn them into clean, ready-to-post short-form videos. The script and the filming are already done, so your job is the edit. Cut and assemble green screen videos and similar short-form formats Drop in simple, relevant B-roll that supports what's being said on screen Keep pacing tight and visuals clear and easy to follow Deliver edits ready to publish across short-form platforms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, etc.) All content is short-form. We want simple, clear, clean visuals. That's the whole brief. Specifically: Yes: straightforward cuts, well-chosen B-roll, clean and readable No: heavy animation, flashy transitions, loud sound effects, or AI-generated media If your instinct is to keep an edit clean and let the content carry it, you'll fit right in. What we're looking for Experience editing short-form video, ideally with a track record of content that performed Reliable, fast turnaround and easy to work with Comfort working from a provided script and footage How to apply Please send: 1. Your portfolio, with links to short-form work you've edited 2. Any relevant experience in social media 3. Anything interesting in health & wellness, or a genuine passion for the food system 4. Links to any viral videos you've edited, with a quick note on what you did 5. A bit about your current work: what other companies or clients you edit for, whether you're working with anyone right now, and whether you'd have the capacity to ramp to full-time with us We review applications on a rolling basis and reach out to strong fits to kick things off. Aiming to start ASAP!

title: Part-Time TikTok Shop Video Editor (CapCut)
description: About the Role We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help edit our short-form TikTok videos. This is a part-time position perfect for someone who works quickly and follows instructions well. The editing required is very basic. You do not need to be an expert video editor. The work mostly involves chopping off the ends of clips, removing dead space, and adding specific overlays or stickers onscreen exactly as we instruct you. If you know how to use CapCut and can follow a simple process, this job will be very easy for you. Work Volume & Schedule You will be editing roughly 4 to 8 short videos per day. Each video should take about 10 minutes on average to edit — some a little more, some a little less. This is a part-time position with a flexible schedule. Requirements • Must use CapCut for all video editing. • Ability to perform basic edits such as trimming clips, adding text, stickers, and overlays. • Good communication skills and ability to follow exact instructions. • A reliable internet connection to download raw footage and upload finished videos. At the subject of your application, put your favorite month of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job. • A willingness to learn and work efficiently. • Bonus (not required): Experience creating AI videos is a plus! Compensation $5.00 USD per hour. How to Apply If you are interested in this position and meet the requirements, please send your application with a brief introduction about yourself and your experience using CapCut. We look forward to hearing from you!
